<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>TicketSafe - Concurrency Safe Ticket Booking</title>

<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=Manrope:wght@600;700;800&display=swap');
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
body{font-family:Inter,Arial,sans-serif;background:#f7f9fc;color:#101828;line-height:1.4}
header{height:74px;background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid #e7eaf0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 4.5%;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50}
.logo{font-family:Manrope,Inter,sans-serif;font-size:29px;font-weight:800;color:#111827;line-height:1}.logo span{color:#6d35df}.logo small{display:block;font:500 12px Inter;color:#172033;margin-top:3px;letter-spacing:.05px}
nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:38px}nav a{color:#111827;text-decoration:none;font-size:14px;font-weight:600}nav a:first-child{color:#6d35df;position:relative}nav a:first-child:after{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:-28px;height:2px;background:#6d35df}
.login-btn{border:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#5f25d5,#7b3ff0);color:#fff;padding:12px 22px;border-radius:8px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(109,53,223,.18)}

.hero{
  display:block;
  width:100%;
  aspect-ratio:967 / 381;
  height:auto;
  background-image:url('data:image/png;base64,');
  background-size:cover;
  background-position:center;
  background-repeat:no-repeat;
  background-size:100% 100%;
  background-position:center;
  position:relative;
}

.booking-box{width:91%;margin:-32px auto 18px;background:#fff;border-radius:20px;padding:18px 12px 18px;box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(16,24,40,.08);position:relative;z-index:5}
.categories{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:13px;margin:0 0 22px}
.category{height:68px;border:0;border-radius:9px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;color:#fff;font:800 15px Inter;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.2px;background:#e5e7eb;box-shadow:0 5px 12px rgba(15,23,42,.08)}
.category:before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background-position:center;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;opacity:1;filter:saturate(.98)}
.category:after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(98,35,218,.95),rgba(109,53,223,.78));}
.category:nth-child(2):after{background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(49,128,219,.84),rgba(54,116,210,.72))}.category:nth-child(3):after{background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(8,18,42,.72),rgba(10,22,54,.88))}
/* PHOTO ONLY: remove all color overlays from category photos */
.category:after,.category:nth-child(1):after,.category:nth-child(2):after,.category:nth-child(3):after,.category:nth-child(4):after,.category:nth-child(5):after,.category:nth-child(6):after,.category:nth-child(7):after,.category:nth-child(8):after{background:transparent!important;}
.category:before{filter:none!important;}
.category{color:#fff;text-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.75);}
.category:nth-child(1):before{background-image:url('data:image/png;base64,')}.category:nth-child(2):before{background-image:url('data:image/png;base64,')}.category:nth-child(3):before{background-image:url('data:image/png;base64,')}
.category>*{position:relative;z-index:2}.category{font-size:15px}.category.active{outline:2px solid rgba(109,53,223,.08)}
.search-area{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 190px;gap:14px}
.search-area select,.search-area input{height:59px;width:100%;padding:12px 16px 12px 48px;border:1px solid #e1e5eb;border-radius:12px;background:#fff;color:#344054;font:500 13px Inter;outline:none}
.search-area select:focus,.search-area input:focus{border-color:#8b5cf6;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(139,92,246,.10)}
.search-area:before{content:'⌖';position:absolute;display:none}
.search-btn{height:59px;border:0;border-radius:11px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#5f25d5,#7b3ff0);color:#fff;font:800 14px Inter;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(109,53,223,.18)}
.container{width:94%;margin:0 auto 35px}.section-title{font:800 20px Manrope,Inter,sans-serif;margin:16px 0 12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}.section-subtitle{display:none}
.results{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px}
.card{background:#fff;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 5px 20px rgba(16,24,40,.08);border:1px solid #eef0f4;transition:.2s}.card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(16,24,40,.11)}
.card-top{height:138px;background:#fff;display:block;position:relative;overflow:hidden}.card-top img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;display:block}.card-content{padding:10px 18px 14px}.card h3{font:800 17px Manrope,Inter,sans-serif;margin-bottom:8px;color:#101828}.info{color:#667085;font-size:13px;margin:7px 0}.price-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-top:13px}.price{font:800 22px Manrope,Inter,sans-serif;color:#111827}.book-btn{border:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#6328dc,#8248ec);color:#fff;padding:10px 19px;border-radius:10px;font:800 13px Inter;cursor:pointer}
.section-block{margin-top:6px}.section-block .section-title{margin-top:14px}.view-all{font:600 13px Inter;color:#6932dc;text-decoration:none}
.booking-section{display:none;width:92%;margin:40px auto;background:#fff;padding:30px;border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.08)}
.booking-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:25px}.timer{background:#fee2e2;color:#dc2626;padding:18px 25px;border-radius:15px;font-size:22px;font-weight:bold}.screen{width:70%;margin:20px auto 35px;background:#374151;color:#fff;padding:15px;border-radius:50%;text-align:center}.seats{max-width:900px;margin:auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(8,1fr);gap:12px}.seat{padding:15px 5px;border:none;border-radius:9px;background:#dcfce7;color:#166534;font-weight:bold;cursor:pointer}.seat:hover{background:#bbf7d0}.seat.selected{background:#6d35df;color:white}.seat.booked{background:#9ca3af;color:white;cursor:not-allowed}.seat-info{text-align:center;margin:25px 0;font-size:17px}.legend{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:25px;margin:20px 0}.legend-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}.legend-box{width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:5px}.available{background:#dcfce7}.selected-box{background:#6d35df}.booked-box{background:#9ca3af}.passenger-box{margin-top:35px;padding:25px;background:#f8fafc;border-radius:15px}.passenger-box h2{margin-bottom:20px}.passenger{background:#fff;padding:20px;border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:15px;border:1px solid #e2e8f0}.passenger h3{margin-bottom:15px}.passenger-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:12px}.passenger input,.passenger select{padding:14px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:8px;font-size:15px;width:100%}.confirm-btn{margin-top:20px;width:100%;padding:17px;border:none;background:#16a34a;color:white;border-radius:10px;font-size:18px;font-weight:bold;cursor:pointer}.success{display:none;text-align:center;padding:40px;background:#ecfdf5;border-radius:15px;margin-top:25px}.success h2{color:#15803d;margin-bottom:10px}footer{background:#111827;color:white;text-align:center;padding:30px;margin-top:60px}
@media(max-width:1000px){nav{gap:18px}.search-area{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.search-btn{grid-column:1/-1}.results{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:650px){header{height:auto;padding:15px 5%;gap:15px;flex-wrap:wrap}nav{order:3;width:100%;justify-content:center;gap:18px}nav a:first-child:after{bottom:-10px}.categories{grid-template-columns:1fr}.search-area{grid-template-columns:1fr}.results{grid-template-columns:1fr}.seats{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}.passenger-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.container,.booking-box{width:94%}}

/* EXACT SCREENSHOT-STYLE FRONTEND */
body{background:#f7f9fc}
.container{width:91%;margin:0 auto}
.section-title{font-size:20px;font-weight:800;margin:20px 0 10px}
.section-block{margin-bottom:24px}
.results{gap:18px}
.card{border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 5px 18px rgba(16,24,40,.10);border:1px solid #edf0f5}
.card-top{height:170px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#fff}
.card-top img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.card-badge{position:absolute;left:10px;top:9px;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:6px;background:#5b2bd8;color:#fff;font-size:10px;font-weight:800}
.card-content{padding:10px 14px 13px}
.card-content h3{font-family:Manrope,Inter,sans-serif;font-size:16px;margin-bottom:8px}
.info{font-size:12px;color:#52637a;margin:5px 0}
.price{font-size:17px;font-weight:800}
.book-btn{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4e20cf,#7138ed);border-radius:8px;padding:9px 17px}
.view-all{font-size:12px}


/* My Bookings */
.my-bookings-section{width:91%;margin:28px auto 50px;background:#fff;border-radius:18px;padding:24px;box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(16,24,40,.08)}
.my-bookings-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:16px;margin-bottom:20px}
.my-bookings-header h2{margin:0;font-size:24px;color:#111827}
.my-bookings-header p{margin:6px 0 0;color:#64748b;font-size:14px}
.back-home-btn{border:0;border-radius:9px;padding:10px 16px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4e20cf,#7138ed);color:#fff;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}
.my-bookings-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px}
.booking-card{border:1px solid #e8eaf0;border-radius:14px;padding:18px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 4px 15px rgba(16,24,40,.06)}
.booking-card h3{margin:0 0 8px;color:#111827;font-size:18px}
.booking-card .booking-meta{color:#64748b;font-size:13px;line-height:1.8}.booking-card .booking-meta strong:first-child{color:#111827}
.booking-card .booking-total{font-size:18px;font-weight:800;color:#111827;margin-top:10px}
.booking-status{display:inline-block;background:#e8fff1;color:#14804a;border-radius:999px;padding:4px 9px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:10px}
.empty-bookings{text-align:center;padding:45px 20px;color:#64748b;border:1px dashed #cfd5df;border-radius:14px}
@media(max-width:760px){.my-bookings-list{grid-template-columns:1fr}.my-bookings-header{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}}


.category{min-width:120px;white-space:nowrap}
.categories{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center}
@media(max-width:900px){.categories{overflow-x:auto;justify-content:flex-start;flex-wrap:nowrap;padding-bottom:6px}.category{min-width:112px}}


.category-extra-image {
  width:100%;
  height:190px;
  object-fit:cover;
  display:block;
}


.passenger-heading{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:12px;
  margin-bottom:15px;
}
.passenger-heading h3{margin-bottom:0}
.remove-passenger-btn{
  border:1px solid #fecaca;
  background:#fff1f2;
  color:#dc2626;
  padding:8px 12px;
  border-radius:8px;
  font-size:12px;
  font-weight:700;
  cursor:pointer;
  white-space:nowrap;
}
.remove-passenger-btn:hover{
  background:#fee2e2;
}
/* =========================================================
   MOVIE / EVENT / PODCAST - CINEMA CLASS SEATING
   Screenshot-style premium / standard / economy layout
========================================================= */
.entertainment-seats{
  display:flex !important;
  flex-direction:column;
  gap:0;
  padding:16px 14px 22px;
  background:#8f8f8f;
  border-radius:8px;
  border:1px solid #777;
  box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.16);
  overflow-x:auto;
}
.cinema-screen{
  width:min(82%,760px);
  margin:2px auto 18px;
  height:48px;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  background:#171717;
  color:#fff;
  border:2px solid #ff2020;
  border-radius:4px;
  box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.28);
  font-size:12px;
  font-weight:800;
  letter-spacing:1.5px;
  position:relative;
}
.cinema-screen:after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  left:12%;
  right:12%;
  bottom:-9px;
  height:5px;
  background:#c9c9c9;
  clip-path:polygon(8% 0,92% 0,100% 100%,0 100%);
}
.cinema-class-section{
  width:min(980px,100%);
  margin:0 auto;
  padding:10px 8px 16px;
}
.cinema-class-section + .cinema-class-section{
  border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.38);
  padding-top:18px;
}
.cinema-class-title{
  text-align:center;
  font-size:12px;
  color:#eeeeee;
  font-weight:700;
  margin:0 0 10px;
}
.cinema-class-title strong{
  color:#fff;
  font-size:13px;
}
.cinema-seat-row{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:26px minmax(0,1fr);
  gap:9px;
  align-items:center;
  margin:5px 0;
}
.cinema-row-label{
  font-size:10px;
  color:#eeeeee;
  font-weight:800;
  text-align:center;
}
.cinema-row-seats{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(16,minmax(26px,1fr));
  gap:5px;
}
.cinema-row-seats .seat:nth-child(8){
  margin-right:12px;
}
.entertainment-seats .seat{
  width:100%;
  min-width:26px;
  height:27px;
  padding:0;
  border-radius:3px;
  font-size:8px;
  font-weight:700;
  color:#475467;
  background:#f1f1f1;
  border:1px solid #d7d7d7;
}
.entertainment-seats .seat:hover:not(:disabled){
  border-color:#6d35df;
  transform:translateY(-1px);
}
.entertainment-seats .seat.selected{
  background:#6d35df;
  border-color:#6d35df;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(109,53,223,.14);
}
.entertainment-seats .seat.booked{
  background:#9d9d9d !important;
  border-color:#909090 !important;
  opacity:.95;
}
@media(max-width:650px){
  .cinema-screen{width:92%;height:42px;font-size:11px}
  .cinema-class-section{min-width:620px}
  .entertainment-seats{padding-left:8px;padding-right:8px}
  .cinema-row-seats{grid-template-columns:repeat(16,25px)}
  .entertainment-seats .seat{min-width:25px;height:25px}
}
.showtime-select:focus{
  border-color:#6d35df;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(109,53,223,.10);
}



/* =========================================================
   TICKETSAFE PRO MAX UI UPGRADE
========================================================= */
:root{
  --ts-purple:#6d35df;--ts-purple2:#8b5cf6;--ts-ink:#101828;--ts-muted:#667085;
  --ts-card:#fff;--ts-line:#e7eaf0;--ts-green:#12b76a;--ts-red:#f04438;
}
.nav-active{color:#6d35df!important}
.pro-nav-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;background:#f1ebff;color:#6330d6;border-radius:999px;padding:4px 8px;font-size:10px;font-weight:800}
.pro-shell{width:min(1180px,92%);margin:30px auto 70px}
.pro-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:20px;margin-bottom:22px}
.pro-top h1{font:800 32px Manrope,Inter,sans-serif;color:#111827}
.pro-top p{color:#667085;margin-top:7px}
.pro-actions{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.ts-btn{border:0;border-radius:11px;padding:11px 15px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;background:#111827;color:#fff}
.ts-btn.secondary{background:#fff;color:#344054;border:1px solid #d0d5dd}
.ts-btn.purple{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#5f25d5,#8b5cf6)}
.ts-btn.danger{background:#fff1f0;color:#d92d20;border:1px solid #fecdca}
.pro-stat-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);gap:13px;margin-bottom:18px}
.pro-stat{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--ts-line);border-radius:16px;padding:17px;box-shadow:0 8px 25px rgba(16,24,40,.04)}
.pro-stat .ico{font-size:22px}.pro-stat strong{display:block;font:800 25px Manrope;margin-top:9px}.pro-stat span{font-size:12px;color:#667085}
.pro-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.25fr .75fr;gap:18px}
.pro-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--ts-line);border-radius:18px;padding:20px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(16,24,40,.04)}
.pro-card h3{font:800 18px Manrope;margin-bottom:15px}
.chart-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:110px 1fr 52px;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin:12px 0;font-size:13px}
.bar-track{height:10px;background:#eef0f5;border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden}.bar-fill{height:100%;border-radius:99px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#6d35df,#a78bfa)}
.recent-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13px}.recent-table th,.recent-table td{padding:11px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid #eef0f4;text-align:left}.recent-table th{color:#667085;font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase}
.status-pill{display:inline-flex;padding:5px 8px;border-radius:999px;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;background:#ecfdf3;color:#027a48}.status-pill.cancelled{background:#fff1f0;color:#d92d20}
.pro-tabs{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow:auto;margin-bottom:16px;padding-bottom:2px}.pro-tab{border:1px solid #e4e7ec;background:#fff;padding:9px 13px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}.pro-tab.active{background:#f1ebff;border-color:#d9c8ff;color:#6330d6}
.pro-panel{display:none}.pro-panel.active{display:block}
.conflict-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}.conflict-user{padding:18px;border-radius:15px;background:#f8f9fc;border:1px solid #eaecf0}.conflict-user h4{margin-bottom:8px}.lock-seat{font:800 28px Manrope;color:#6d35df}.race-log{margin-top:15px;background:#101828;color:#d0d5dd;border-radius:14px;padding:15px;font:12px ui-monospace,monospace;min-height:150px;white-space:pre-wrap}
.ticket-overlay,.quick-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(16,24,40,.62);backdrop-filter:blur(5px);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:1000;padding:18px}
.ticket-modal{width:min(720px,100%);max-height:92vh;overflow:auto;background:#fff;border-radius:22px;box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
.ticket-head{padding:20px 22px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#16132a,#6d35df);color:#fff;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:15px}.ticket-head h2{font:800 24px Manrope}.ticket-close{background:rgba(255,255,255,.16);border:0;color:#fff;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:10px;font-size:22px;cursor:pointer}
.ticket-body{padding:22px}.ticket-main{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 150px;gap:20px;align-items:center}.ticket-id{color:#6d35df;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.06em}.ticket-route{font:800 21px Manrope;margin:7px 0 18px}.ticket-details{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}.ticket-detail{background:#f8f9fc;border:1px solid #eaecf0;padding:11px;border-radius:11px}.ticket-detail small{display:block;color:#667085;font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:800}.ticket-detail strong{display:block;margin-top:3px}
.qr-demo{width:145px;height:145px;border:9px solid #fff;outline:1px solid #d0d5dd;background-color:#fff;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(13,1fr);gap:2px;padding:7px;box-shadow:0 5px 20px rgba(16,24,40,.1)}
.qr-demo i{background:#101828}.qr-demo i:nth-child(3n){background:transparent}.qr-demo i:nth-child(7n){background:#6d35df}.qr-note{text-align:center;font-size:9px;color:#667085;margin-top:7px}
.ticket-foot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:20px;padding-top:18px;border-top:1px dashed #d0d5dd}.ticket-total{font:900 24px Manrope;color:#111827}
.notify-panel{width:min(560px,100%);background:#fff;border-radius:20px;padding:22px}.notify-item{padding:14px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #eaecf0;display:flex;gap:12px}.notify-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:#6d35df;margin-top:5px;flex:none}
.profile-card{display:grid;grid-template-columns:110px 1fr;gap:22px;align-items:center}.avatar{width:100px;height:100px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#6d35df,#b69cff);color:#fff;font:900 35px Manrope}.profile-fields{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}.profile-field{padding:13px;background:#f8f9fc;border-radius:12px}.profile-field small{display:block;color:#667085;font-weight:800;font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase}.profile-field strong{display:block;margin-top:4px}
.search-enhanced{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:1.6fr 1fr 1fr auto;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:14px!important;background:#fff;border:1px solid #e4e7ec;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 8px 25px rgba(16,24,40,.05);margin-top:16px}
.search-enhanced input,.search-enhanced select{border:1px solid #d0d5dd;border-radius:10px;padding:12px;background:#fff;outline:none;font:500 13px Inter}.search-enhanced input:focus,.search-enhanced select:focus{border-color:#8b5cf6;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #f1ebff}
.search-count{font-size:12px;color:#667085;margin-top:10px}

.service-extra{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:9px 0}.service-tag{background:#f1ebff;color:#6330d6;padding:4px 7px;border-radius:999px;font-size:10px;font-weight:800}
.booking-progress{display:flex;gap:7px;margin:0 0 18px;flex-wrap:wrap}.progress-step{padding:8px 11px;border-radius:999px;background:#f2f4f7;color:#667085;font-size:11px;font-weight:800}.progress-step.active{background:#f1ebff;color:#6330d6}
.cancel-note{font-size:11px;color:#667085;margin-top:8px}.empty-pro{padding:30px;text-align:center;color:#667085}

<style>
/* =========================================================
   CRICKET + KABADDI STADIUM-STYLE BOOKING MAPS
========================================================= */

.stadium-seats{
    max-width:1100px !important;
    display:block !important;
    margin:0 auto !important;
}

.sports-map{
    position:relative;
    width:min(100%,1200px);
    margin:0 auto;
    min-height:760px;
    border-radius:28px;
    background:#f8fafc;
    border:1px solid #e5e7eb;
    overflow:hidden;
}

/* ---------- Cricket ---------- */
.cricket-map{
    min-height:760px;
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at center, #eef2f7 0 31%, #dfe5ec 31.2% 32%, #f8fafc 32.3% 47%, #e9edf3 47.3% 48%, #f8fafc 48.3%);
}

.cricket-field{
    position:absolute;
    width:390px;
    height:390px;
    left:50%;
    top:50%;
    transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
    border-radius:50%;
    background:#18a900;
    border:13px solid #d8dee7;
    box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #ffffff inset, 0 12px 28px rgba(15,23,42,.10);
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
}

.field-boundary{
    position:absolute;
    inset:20px;
    border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.85);
    border-radius:50%;
}

.cricket-pitch{
    width:42px;
    height:150px;
    background:#e9c44a;
    border:3px solid rgba(255,255,255,.45);
    border-radius:3px;
    z-index:2;
}

.field-label{
    position:absolute;
    z-index:3;
    color:#fff;
    font-size:13px;
    font-weight:800;
    letter-spacing:1px;
    text-align:center;
    line-height:1.25;
    top:78px;
    opacity:.95;
}

.cricket-stand,
.kabaddi-stand{
    position:absolute;
    z-index:5;
    background:#fff;
    border:1px solid #dfe4eb;
    box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(16,24,40,.10);
    padding:12px;
    text-align:center;
}

.cricket-stand{
    width:330px;
    border-radius:22px;
}

.cricket-stand.north{top:18px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%)}
.cricket-stand.south{bottom:18px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%)}
.cricket-stand.east{right:18px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:330px}
.cricket-stand.west{left:18px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:330px}

.stand-title{
    font-size:15px;
    font-weight:800;
    color:#111827;
}

.stand-subtitle{
    margin-top:2px;
    color:#64748b;
    font-size:11px;
    font-weight:700;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    letter-spacing:.8px;
}

.stand-seats{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(10,1fr);
    gap:4px;
    margin-top:8px;
}

.cricket-stand.east .stand-seats,
.cricket-stand.west .stand-seats,
.kabaddi-stand .stand-seats,
.kabaddi-stand.stand-b .stand-seats,
.kabaddi-stand.stand-d .stand-seats{
    grid-template-columns:repeat(10,1fr);
}

.cricket-stand .seat,
.kabaddi-stand .seat{
    padding:4px 1px;
    min-height:22px;
    border-radius:6px;
    font-size:9px;
}

.gate{
    position:absolute;
    z-index:7;
    background:#374151;
    color:#fff;
    font-size:10px;
    font-weight:800;
    letter-spacing:.5px;
    padding:7px 11px;
    border-radius:999px;
}

.gate-n{top:0;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-2px)}
.gate-s{bottom:0;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,2px)}
.gate-e{right:0;top:50%;transform:translate(2px,-50%) rotate(90deg)}
.gate-w{left:0;top:50%;transform:translate(-2px,-50%) rotate(-90deg)}

/* ---------- Kabaddi ---------- */
.kabaddi-map{
    min-height:610px;
    background:#f1f3f5;
}

.kabaddi-court{
    position:absolute;
    width:390px;
    height:230px;
    left:50%;
    top:50%;
    transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
    background:#e8d6c2;
    border:12px solid #ffffff;
    box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #cbd5e1, 0 14px 30px rgba(15,23,42,.10);
    z-index:2;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
}

.kabaddi-court:before,
.kabaddi-court:after{
    content:"";
    position:absolute;
    left:50%;
    top:0;
    bottom:0;
    width:2px;
    background:#7c5a3c;
    transform:translateX(-50%);
}

.kabaddi-court:after{
    width:80px;
    height:80px;
    top:50%;
    left:50%;
    bottom:auto;
    border:2px solid #7c5a3c;
    border-radius:50%;
    background:transparent;
    transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
}

.mid-line{
    position:absolute;
    left:50%;
    top:0;
    bottom:0;
    width:2px;
    background:#7c5a3c;
    transform:translateX(-50%);
}

.bonus-line{
    position:absolute;
    top:22%;
    bottom:22%;
    width:2px;
    background:#7c5a3c;
}
.bonus-line.left{left:28%}
.bonus-line.right{right:28%}

.court-title{
    z-index:3;
    text-align:center;
    font-size:17px;
    font-weight:900;
    color:#5b4634;
    letter-spacing:1px;
    line-height:1.2;
}

.court-center{
    position:absolute;
    bottom:10px;
    left:50%;
    transform:translateX(-50%);
    font-size:8px;
    font-weight:800;
    color:#7c5a3c;
}

.kabaddi-stand{
    z-index:5;
    width:330px;
    min-height:120px;
    border-radius:18px;
}

.kabaddi-stand.stand-c{top:18px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%)}
.kabaddi-stand.stand-a{bottom:18px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%)}
.kabaddi-stand.stand-b{right:18px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:330px}
.kabaddi-stand.stand-d{left:18px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:330px}

.kabaddi-stand .stand-seats{
    grid-template-columns:repeat(10,1fr);
}

.kabaddi-stand.stand-b .stand-seats,
.kabaddi-stand.stand-d .stand-seats{
    grid-template-columns:repeat(10,1fr);
}

.kabaddi-entry{
    position:absolute;
    z-index:7;
    background:#ffffff;
    color:#111827;
    border:1px solid #d7dce4;
    box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(16,24,40,.08);
    padding:7px 10px;
    border-radius:6px;
    text-align:center;
    font-size:9px;
    line-height:1.2;
    font-weight:800;
}
.entry-top{top:0;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-2px)}
.entry-bottom{bottom:0;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,2px)}
.entry-right{right:0;top:50%;transform:translate(2px,-50%) rotate(90deg)}
.entry-left{left:0;top:50%;transform:translate(-2px,-50%) rotate(-90deg)}

.sports-map .seat.booked{
    background:#9ca3af !important;
    color:#fff !important;
}
.sports-map .seat.selected{
    background:#6d35df !important;
    color:#fff !important;
    box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(109,53,223,.15);
}

@media(max-width:850px){
    .sports-map{min-height:760px}
    .cricket-field{width:300px;height:300px}
    .cricket-stand,.kabaddi-stand{
        width:250px !important;
    }
    .cricket-stand.east,.cricket-stand.west,
    .kabaddi-stand.stand-b,.kabaddi-stand.stand-d{
        width:250px !important;
    }
    .stand-seats{gap:4px}
    .cricket-stand .seat,.kabaddi-stand .seat{
        font-size:8px;
        padding:5px 1px;
        min-height:27px;
    }
    .kabaddi-court{width:310px;height:190px}
}

@media(max-width:650px){
    .sports-map{min-height:1450px}
    .stand-seats{grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr) !important}

    .cricket-field{width:245px;height:245px}
    .cricket-stand,.kabaddi-stand{
        width:210px !important;
    }
    .cricket-stand.north,.kabaddi-stand.stand-c{top:35px}
    .cricket-stand.south,.kabaddi-stand.stand-a{bottom:35px}
    .cricket-stand.east,.cricket-stand.west,
    .kabaddi-stand.stand-b,.kabaddi-stand.stand-d{
        top:auto;
        transform:none;
        width:210px !important;
    }
    .cricket-stand.east,.kabaddi-stand.stand-b{right:15px;bottom:315px}
    .cricket-stand.west,.kabaddi-stand.stand-d{left:15px;bottom:315px}
    .kabaddi-court{width:270px;height:170px}
    .gate,.kabaddi-entry{display:none}
}

/* =========================================================
   SCREENSHOT-STYLE TRANSPORT SEATING
   BUS / TRAIN / FLIGHT
========================================================= */
.transport-seats{
    display:block !important;
    max-width:1050px !important;
    margin:0 auto !important;
    overflow-x:auto;
    padding:12px 10px 20px;
}
.transport-map{
    width:min(100%,920px);
    min-width:520px;
    margin:0 auto;
    position:relative;
    background:#fff;
    border:1px solid #d9dee7;
    border-radius:18px;
    box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(16,24,40,.10);
    padding:18px;
}
.transport-legend{
    display:flex;
    justify-content:center;
    gap:24px;
    align-items:center;
    font-size:12px;
    color:#52637a;
    margin-bottom:14px;
}
.transport-legend span{
    display:inline-flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:6px;
}
.transport-dot{
    width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;display:inline-block;
}
.transport-dot.available{background:#3bbf9b}
.transport-dot.unavailable{background:#aeb5bd}
.transport-dot.assigned{background:#263f55}

.transport-seat{
    border:0;
    cursor:pointer;
    font:800 10px Inter,Arial,sans-serif;
    transition:.15s ease;
}
.transport-seat.available{
    background:#36b995;
    color:#fff;
}
.transport-seat.available:hover{
    transform:scale(1.08);
    box-shadow:0 3px 8px rgba(16,24,40,.16);
}
.transport-seat.selected{
    background:#6d35df !important;
    color:#fff !important;
    box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(109,53,223,.18);
}
.transport-seat.booked{
    background:#aeb5bd !important;
    color:#fff !important;
    cursor:not-allowed;
}
.transport-label{
    color:#475467;
    font-size:10px;
    font-weight:800;
}

/* ---------- BUS: 2 x 2 coach ---------- */
/* ---------- BUS: screenshot-style narrow 1 + 2 coach ---------- */
.bus-layout{
    width:270px; min-width:270px; padding:8px 9px 13px;
    border:3px solid #7f858b; border-radius:14px 14px 18px 18px;
    background:#f4f6f8; box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(16,24,40,.12);
}
.bus-front{
    height:57px; margin:-1px -1px 9px; border-radius:10px 10px 4px 4px;
    background:#22252a; display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
    gap:7px; padding:7px;
}
.bus-driver{
    width:auto;height:42px;border-radius:5px;background:#f1a21a;
    border:3px solid #444; display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    color:#fff;font-size:0; box-shadow:inset 0 -3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.16);
}
.bus-driver::after{content:"";width:12px;height:15px;border-radius:3px;background:#f7b531}
.bus-steering{display:none}
.bus-front::after{
    content:"DRIVER"; position:absolute; margin-top:44px; margin-left:2px;
    color:#d0d5dd;font-size:7px;font-weight:800;
}
.bus-rows{display:grid;grid-template-columns:20px 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:4px;align-items:center}
.bus-row-number{text-align:center;color:#667085;font-size:8px;font-weight:800}
.bus-aisle{display:none}
.bus-seat{
    height:22px;min-width:0;border-radius:4px 4px 3px 3px;
    border:1px solid #1c6e9f;box-shadow:inset 0 -2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.12);font-size:7px;
}
.bus-seat.available{background:#25a9dd;color:#fff}
.bus-seat.selected{background:#6d35df !important;border-color:#5b22c9 !important}
.bus-seat.booked{background:#9ca3af !important;border-color:#858b92 !important}
.bus-last-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:20px repeat(4,1fr);gap:4px;align-items:center;margin-top:4px}
/* ---------- TRAIN: coach with aisle ---------- */
.train-layout{
    width:420px;
    min-width:420px;
    padding:16px 24px 24px;
    border:2px solid #cfd5dc;
    border-radius:18px;
    background:#f8fafc;
}
.train-header{
    display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;
    color:#344054;font-weight:900;font-size:12px;margin-bottom:12px;
}
.train-coach{
    border:1px solid #d8dde5;
    border-radius:10px;
    padding:12px 14px 15px;
    background:#fff;
}
.train-columns{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:26px 1fr 1fr 34px 1fr 1fr;
    gap:6px;
    align-items:center;
}
.train-row-number{
    color:#667085;font-size:9px;font-weight:800;text-align:center;
}
.train-seat{
    height:29px;
    border-radius:5px;
    font-size:9px;
}
.train-aisle{
    height:29px;
    border-left:2px dashed #d0d5dd;
    border-right:2px dashed #d0d5dd;
    background:#f8fafc;
}

/* ---------- FLIGHT: economy 3-3 ---------- */
.flight-layout{
    width:610px;
    min-width:610px;
    padding:12px 22px 22px;
    background:#fff;
    border:1px solid #d9dee7;
    border-radius:14px;
}
.flight-cabin-title{
    height:28px;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:space-between;
    border-bottom:1px solid #d5d9df;
    color:#344054;
    font-size:11px;
    font-weight:900;
}
.flight-class{
    font-weight:900;
    font-size:12px;
}
.flight-column-labels{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:34px repeat(3,1fr) 36px repeat(3,1fr);
    gap:6px;
    margin:8px 0 5px;
    text-align:center;
    color:#475467;
    font-size:9px;
    font-weight:900;
}
.flight-row{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:34px repeat(3,1fr) 36px repeat(3,1fr);
    gap:6px;
    align-items:center;
    margin:4px 0;
}
.flight-row-number{
    color:#344054;
    font-size:9px;
    font-weight:800;
    text-align:center;
}
.flight-seat{
    height:25px;
    border-radius:5px 5px 3px 3px;
    font-size:8px;
    box-shadow:inset 0 -2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.08);
}
.flight-aisle{
    height:25px;
    position:relative;
}
.flight-door{
    height:46px;
    margin:7px -8px;
    background:#e1e4e8;
    border-radius:4px;
}
.flight-door.exit{
    background:#b40000;
}
.flight-legend{
    margin-top:12px;
}

@media(max-width:650px){
    .transport-map{min-width:500px}
    .flight-layout{transform-origin:top left}
}

</style>

 .hero-copy{top:53%;left:20px;right:20px}

}

<style id="ticketsafe-v2-css">

.ts-mobile-menu{display:none;position:fixed;top:74px;left:0;right:0;background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid #e7eaf0;box-shadow:0 14px 28px rgba(16,24,40,.12);padding:12px 18px;z-index:60}
.ts-mobile-menu.open{display:grid;gap:6px}
.ts-mobile-menu a,.ts-mobile-menu button{display:block;width:100%;padding:12px 14px;border:0;background:#fff;text-align:left;text-decoration:none;color:#172033;font:700 14px Inter;cursor:pointer;border-radius:9px}
.ts-mobile-menu a:hover,.ts-mobile-menu button:hover{background:#f6f3ff;color:#6d35df}
.booking-tools{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:0 0 18px;padding:14px;border:1px solid #e7eaf0;border-radius:14px;background:#fff}
.booking-tools input,.booking-tools select{border:1px solid #d8dee8;border-radius:9px;padding:10px 12px;font:500 13px Inter;outline:none;background:#fff}
.booking-tools input{flex:1;min-width:220px}
.booking-tools button{border:0;border-radius:9px;padding:10px 14px;background:#6d35df;color:#fff;font:700 13px Inter;cursor:pointer}
.booking-filter-tabs{display:flex;gap:7px;margin:0 0 14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.booking-filter-tabs button{border:1px solid #dfe3ea;background:#fff;color:#475467;border-radius:999px;padding:8px 13px;font:700 12px Inter;cursor:pointer}
.booking-filter-tabs button.active{background:#6d35df;color:#fff;border-color:#6d35df}
.booking-card{transition:transform .18s ease,box-shadow .18s ease}
.booking-card:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(16,24,40,.08)}
.quick-ticket-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:12px}
.quick-ticket-actions button{border:1px solid #dfe3ea;background:#fff;color:#344054;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 11px;font:700 12px Inter;cursor:pointer}
.quick-ticket-actions .primary{background:#6d35df;color:#fff;border-color:#6d35df}
@media(max-width:900px){header nav{display:none}.ts-mobile-toggle{display:block;position:absolute;right:18px;top:16px}.ts-mobile-menu{top:74px}.logo{font-size:25px}}
@media(max-width:600px){.booking-tools{padding:10px}.booking-tools input,.booking-tools select{width:100%;min-width:0}.booking-tools button{width:100%}}
</style>
</head>

<body>

<header>
  <div class="logo">Ticket<span>Safe</span><small>Concurrency Safe Booking</small></div>
  <nav>
    <a id="homeNav" class="nav-active" href="#" onclick="showHome();return false;">Home</a><a id="bookingsNav" href="#myBookings" onclick="showMyBookings();return false;">My Bookings</a><a id="proNav" href="#proCenter" onclick="openProDashboard();return false;">Pro Center</a><a id="notifyNav" href="#notifications" onclick="openNotifications();return false;">🔔</a><a id="offersNav" href="#offers" onclick="showInfoPage('offers');return false;">Offers</a><a id="helpNav" href="#help" onclick="showInfoPage('help');return false;">Help Center</a><a id="aboutNav" href="#about" onclick="showInfoPage('about');return false;">About Us</a>
    <button class="login-btn" onclick="openAuthModal('login')">♙&nbsp; Login / Signup</button>
  </nav>
</header>
<button class="ts-mobile-toggle" id="tsMobileToggle" aria-label="Open menu" onclick="toggleTSMobileMenu()">☰</button>
<div class="ts-mobile-menu" id="tsMobileMenu">
  <a href="#" onclick="showHome();closeTSMobileMenu();return false;">⌂ Home</a>
  <a href="#myBookings" onclick="showMyBookings();closeTSMobileMenu();return false;">🎟 My Bookings</a>
  <button onclick="openProfile();closeTSMobileMenu()">👤 Profile</button>
  <button onclick="openNotifications();closeTSMobileMenu()">🔔 Notifications</button>
  <button onclick="openProDashboard();closeTSMobileMenu()">⚡ Pro Center</button>
  <a href="#offers" onclick="showInfoPage('offers');closeTSMobileMenu();return false;">🏷 Offers</a>
  <a href="#help" onclick="showInfoPage('help');closeTSMobileMenu();return false;">❓ Help Center</a>
</div>

<!-- HERO PHOTO — appears above the category buttons -->
<div class="hero" aria-label="TicketSafe travel booking banner">
  <div class="hero-shade"></div>
  <div class="hero-copy">
    <span class="hero-badge">🔐 SAFE • SIMPLE • FAST</span>
    <h1>One place for every ticket.</h1>
    <p>Book buses, trains, flights, movies, events and sports with a clean, secure booking experience.</p>
    <div class="hero-actions">
      <button class="hero-primary" onclick="document.getElementById('explore').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'})">Explore Tickets <span>→</span></button>
      <button class="hero-secondary" onclick="showMyBookings()">View My Bookings</button>
    </div>
    <div class="hero-mini-stats">
      <span><b>8+</b> Categories</span>
      <span><b>6</b> Seats / booking</span>
      <span><b>100%</b> Browser demo</span>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>





<!-- BOOKING SEARCH -->

<div class="booking-box">

    <div class="categories">
<button class="category active" onclick="changeCategory('bus', this)">🚌 BUS</button>
<button class="category" onclick="changeCategory('train', this)">🚆 TRAIN</button>
<button class="category" onclick="changeCategory('flight', this)">✈️ FLIGHT</button>
<button class="category" onclick="changeCategory('movie', this)">🎬 MOVIES</button>
<button class="category" onclick="changeCategory('event', this)">🎟️ EVENTS</button>
<button class="category" onclick="changeCategory('podcast', this)">🎙️ PODCASTS</button>
<button class="category" onclick="changeCategory('cricket', this)">🏏 CRICKET</button>
<button class="category" onclick="changeCategory('kabaddi', this)">🤼 KABADDI</button>
</div>

    <div class="search-area" id="travelSearch">



</div>

</div>

<!-- RESULTS -->

<div class="container" id="explore">
  <div class="section-block" id="popularBlock">
    <div class="section-title"><span>Popular Services</span><a class="view-all" href="#" onclick="showAllCategory(currentCategory);return false;">View All →</a></div>
    <div class="results" id="popularResults"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="section-block" id="activeBlock" style="display:none">
    <div class="section-title"><span id="resultTitle">Available Services</span><a class="view-all" href="#" onclick="showPopular();return false;">Popular Services →</a></div>
    <div class="results" id="results"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- MY BOOKINGS -->
<section id="myBookings" class="my-bookings-section" style="display:none;">
  <div class="my-bookings-header">
    <div>
      <h2>My Bookings</h2>
      <p>View, print, save or cancel tickets booked from this browser.</p>
    </div>
    <button class="back-home-btn" onclick="showHome()">← Back to Home</button>
  </div>
  <div class="booking-tools">
    <input id="tsBookingSearch" type="search" placeholder="🔎 Search Booking ID, service or route..." oninput="filterTSBookings()">
    <select id="tsBookingSort" onchange="filterTSBookings()">
      <option value="latest">Latest first</option><option value="oldest">Oldest first</option><option value="amountHigh">Amount: High → Low</option><option value="amountLow">Amount: Low → High</option>
    </select>
    <button onclick="clearTSBookingFilter()">Clear</button>
  </div>
  <div class="booking-filter-tabs">
    <button class="active" data-ts-status="all" onclick="setTSBookingStatus('all',this)">All</button>
    <button data-ts-status="CONFIRMED" onclick="setTSBookingStatus('CONFIRMED',this)">Upcoming / Confirmed</button>
    <button data-ts-status="CANCELLED" onclick="setTSBookingStatus('CANCELLED',this)">Cancelled</button>
  </div>
  <div id="myBookingsList" class="my-bookings-list"></div>
</section>

<!-- SEAT BOOKING -->

<section class="booking-section" id="bookingSection">

    <div class="booking-header">

        <div>
            <h1 id="bookingTitle">Select Seats</h1>
            <p id="bookingRoute"></p>
        </div>

        <div class="timer" id="timer">
            ⏱️ 05:00
        </div>

    </div>

    <div class="screen" id="bookingScreenLabel">
        SEAT / SCREEN / COACH
    </div>

    <div class="seats" id="seatContainer"></div>

    <div class="seat-info">
        Selected Seats:
        <strong id="selectedCount">0</strong> / 6
    </div>

    <div class="legend">

        <div class="legend-item">
            <div class="legend-box available"></div>
            Available
        </div>

        <div class="legend-item">
            <div class="legend-box selected-box"></div>
            Selected
        </div>

        <div class="legend-item">
            <div class="legend-box booked-box"></div>
            Booked
        </div>

    </div>

    <!-- PASSENGER DETAILS -->

    <div class="passenger-box">

        <h2 id="travelerDetailsTitle">Passenger Details</h2>

        <p id="travelerDetailsText" style="margin-bottom:20px;color:#64748b;">
            Enter one passenger for every selected seat.
            Maximum 6 passengers.
        </p>

        <div id="passengerContainer"></div>

        <button class="confirm-btn" onclick="confirmBooking()">
            Book Ticket
        </button>

    </div>

    <div class="success" id="successBox">

        <h2>🎉 Booking Confirmed!</h2>

        <p id="successText"></p>

    </div>

</section>

<!-- OFFERS / HELP / ABOUT -->
<section id="offers" class="info-sections">
  <div class="info-section-inner">
    <div class="info-heading">
      <button class="info-back-btn" onclick="showHome()">← Back to Home</button>
      <span class="info-kicker">SAVE MORE</span>
      <h2>Offers & Deals</h2>
      <p>Use these TicketSafe offers while booking your next ticket.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="offer-grid">
      <article class="offer-card">
        <div class="offer-icon">🎟️</div>
        <div><h3>First Booking</h3><p>Get <strong>₹150 OFF</strong> on your first booking above ₹999.</p><span class="offer-code">WELCOME150</span></div>
      </article>
      <article class="offer-card">
        <div class="offer-icon">🚌</div>
        <div><h3>Bus Deal</h3><p>Flat <strong>10% OFF</strong> on selected bus routes.</p><span class="offer-code">BUS10</span></div>
      </article>
      <article class="offer-card">
        <div class="offer-icon">🎬</div>
        <div><h3>Movie Offer</h3><p>Save <strong>₹100 OFF</strong> on movie bookings above ₹500.</p><span class="offer-code">MOVIE100</span></div>
      </article>
      <article class="offer-card">
        <div class="offer-icon">🏟️</div>
        <div><h3>Events Special</h3><p>Get <strong>15% OFF</strong> on selected event tickets.</p><span class="offer-code">EVENT15</span></div>
      </article>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="help" class="info-sections help-section">
  <div class="info-section-inner two-col-info">
    <div class="info-heading">
      <button class="info-back-btn" onclick="showHome()">← Back to Home</button>
      <span class="info-kicker">NEED HELP?</span>
      <h2>Help Center</h2>
      <p>Our support team can help with bookings, cancellations and ticket issues.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="contact-cards">
      <div class="contact-card"><span>📞</span><div><small>Booking Support</small><strong>+91 90000 12345</strong><p>10:00 AM – 8:00 PM</p></div></div>
      <div class="contact-card"><span>☎️</span><div><small>Customer Care</small><strong>+91 90000 67890</strong><p>10:00 AM – 8:00 PM</p></div></div>
      <div class="contact-card"><span>✉️</span><div><small>Email Support</small><strong>support@ticketsafe.in</strong><p>Response within 24 hours</p></div></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="about" class="info-sections about-section">
  <div class="info-section-inner about-card">
    <div class="about-logo-wrap"><button class="info-back-btn" onclick="showHome()">← Back to Home</button><div class="about-logo">Ticket<span>Safe</span></div>
    </div>
    <div>
      <span class="info-kicker">ABOUT TICKETSAFE</span>
      <h2>Simple, secure ticket booking.</h2>
      <p>TicketSafe is a unified ticket booking platform for buses, trains, flights, movies, events, podcasts, cricket and kabaddi. We make seat selection, passenger details and booking management simple from one place.</p>
      <div class="about-stats"><div><strong>8+</strong><span>Categories</span></div><div><strong>200</strong><span>Stadium Seats</span></div><div><strong>24/7</strong><span>Online Booking</span></div></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- LOGIN / SIGNUP MODAL -->
<div id="authModal" class="auth-overlay" onclick="closeAuthOnBackdrop(event)">
  <div class="auth-modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="authTitle">
    <button class="auth-close" onclick="closeAuthModal()" aria-label="Close">×</button>
    <div class="auth-brand">Ticket<span>Safe</span></div>
    <h2 id="authTitle">Welcome back</h2>
    <p id="authSubtitle">Login to manage your bookings.</p>

    <div class="auth-tabs">
      <button id="loginTab" class="auth-tab active" onclick="switchAuthMode('login')">Login</button>
      <button id="signupTab" class="auth-tab" onclick="switchAuthMode('signup')">Sign Up</button>
    </div>

    <form id="authForm" onsubmit="handleAuth(event)">
      <div id="nameField" class="auth-field" style="display:none;">
        <label>Full Name</label>
        <input id="authName" type="text" placeholder="Enter your name">
      </div>
      <div class="auth-field">
        <label>Email</label>
        <input id="authEmail" type="email" placeholder="Enter your email" required>
      </div>
      <div class="auth-field">
        <label>Password</label>
        <input id="authPassword" type="password" placeholder="Enter your password" minlength="6" required>
      </div>
      <div id="confirmPasswordField" class="auth-field" style="display:none;">
        <label>Confirm Password</label>
        <input id="authConfirmPassword" type="password" placeholder="Re-enter your password" minlength="6">
      </div>
      <button id="authSubmit" class="auth-submit" type="submit">Login</button>
    </form>
    <p id="authMessage" class="auth-message"></p>
    <small class="auth-note">Demo account data is stored in this browser only.</small>
  </div>
</div>


<!-- =========================================================
     TICKETSAFE PRO CENTER
========================================================= -->
<section id="proCenter" class="pro-shell" style="display:none;">
  <div class="pro-top">
    <div>
      <div class="pro-nav-badge">⚡ TICKETSAFE PRO CONTROL CENTER</div>
      <h1>Booking Intelligence Dashboard</h1>
      <p>Live browser demo of bookings, seat activity, concurrency and customer usage.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="pro-actions">
      <button class="ts-btn secondary" onclick="openProfile()">👤 Profile</button>
      <button class="ts-btn secondary" onclick="exportTicketSafeData()">⬇ Export Data</button>
      <button class="ts-btn purple" onclick="runRaceSimulation()">⚡ Run Concurrency Test</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="pro-tabs">
    <button class="pro-tab active" onclick="switchProTab('overview',this)">Overview</button>
    <button class="pro-tab" onclick="switchProTab('bookings',this)">Bookings</button>
    <button class="pro-tab" onclick="switchProTab('concurrency',this)">Concurrency Lab</button>
    <button class="pro-tab" onclick="switchProTab('profile',this)">Profile</button>
  </div>

  <div id="pro-overview" class="pro-panel active">
    <div class="pro-stat-grid">
      <div class="pro-stat"><div class="ico">🎟️</div><strong id="statBookings">0</strong><span>Total Bookings</span></div>
      <div class="pro-stat"><div class="ico">🪑</div><strong id="statSeats">0</strong><span>Seats Sold</span></div>
      <div class="pro-stat"><div class="ico">⚡</div><strong id="statLocks">0</strong><span>Active Locks</span></div>
      <div class="pro-stat"><div class="ico">🛡️</div><strong id="statConflicts">0</strong><span>Conflicts Prevented</span></div>
      <div class="pro-stat"><div class="ico">📊</div><strong id="statValue">₹0</strong><span>Booking Value</span></div>
      <div class="pro-stat"><div class="ico">❌</div><strong id="statCancelled">0</strong><span>Cancelled</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="pro-grid">
      <div class="pro-card"><h3>📈 Category Analytics</h3><div id="categoryAnalytics"></div></div>
      <div class="pro-card"><h3>🔔 System Health</h3><div id="systemHealth"></div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="pro-card" style="margin-top:18px"><h3>🕘 Recent Booking Activity</h3><div id="recentActivity"></div></div>
  </div>

  <div id="pro-bookings" class="pro-panel">
    <div class="pro-card">
      <div class="pro-top" style="margin-bottom:15px"><div><h3 style="margin:0">All Booking Records</h3><p style="margin-top:5px">Search, view, print and cancel local demo tickets.</p></div><input id="adminBookingSearch" oninput="renderAdminBookings()" placeholder="Search Booking ID / service" style="padding:11px;border:1px solid #d0d5dd;border-radius:10px;min-width:240px"></div>
      <div id="adminBookingsList"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div id="pro-concurrency" class="pro-panel">
    <div class="pro-grid">
      <div class="pro-card">
        <h3>🔐 Concurrency Safe Seat Lock</h3>
        <p style="color:#667085;margin-bottom:15px">Two simulated users request the same seat. Only one request is allowed to acquire the lock.</p>
        <div class="conflict-grid">
          <div class="conflict-user"><h4>👤 User A</h4><div class="lock-seat" id="raceSeat">A15</div><p id="raceA">Waiting...</p></div>
          <div class="conflict-user"><h4>👤 User B</h4><div class="lock-seat">A15</div><p id="raceB">Waiting...</p></div>
        </div>
        <button class="ts-btn purple" style="margin-top:15px" onclick="runRaceSimulation()">Run Race Condition</button>
        <div class="race-log" id="raceLog">Click “Run Race Condition” to start a safe-lock simulation.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="pro-card">
        <h3>🧠 How TicketSafe Prevents Double Booking</h3>
        <ol style="padding-left:20px;color:#475467;line-height:1.9">
          <li>User selects a seat.</li><li>System requests a temporary lock.</li><li>Second request for the same seat is rejected.</li><li>Confirmed booking is stored with a unique Booking ID.</li><li>Expired locks can be released automatically.</li>
        </ol>
        <div class="service-extra" style="margin-top:16px"><span class="service-tag">Seat Lock</span><span class="service-tag">Race Test</span><span class="service-tag">Transaction Ready</span><span class="service-tag">Unique Booking ID</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div id="pro-profile" class="pro-panel">
    <div class="pro-card">
      <div id="profilePanel"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- =========================================================
     DIGITAL TICKET MODAL
========================================================= -->
<div id="ticketOverlay" class="ticket-overlay" onclick="closeTicketOnBackdrop(event)">
  <div class="ticket-modal">
    <div class="ticket-head"><div><div style="font-size:11px;opacity:.75;font-weight:800">TICKETSAFE DIGITAL TICKET</div><h2 id="ticketService">Confirmed Ticket</h2></div><button class="ticket-close" onclick="closeTicketModal()">×</button></div>
    <div class="ticket-body">
      <div class="ticket-main">
        <div>
          <div class="ticket-id" id="ticketBookingId">TS--------</div>
          <div class="ticket-route" id="ticketRoute">—</div>
          <div class="ticket-details">
            <div class="ticket-detail"><small>Category</small><strong id="ticketCategory">—</strong></div>
            <div class="ticket-detail"><small>Status</small><strong id="ticketStatus">CONFIRMED</strong></div>
            <div class="ticket-detail"><small>Date</small><strong id="ticketDate">—</strong></div>
            <div class="ticket-detail"><small>Time</small><strong id="ticketTime">—</strong></div>
            <div class="ticket-detail"><small>Seats</small><strong id="ticketSeats">—</strong></div>
            <div class="ticket-detail"><small>Persons</small><strong id="ticketPersons">—</strong></div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div><div id="ticketQr" class="qr-demo"></div><div class="qr-note">DEMO VERIFICATION QR</div></div>
      </div>
      <div class="ticket-foot"><div><div style="font-size:11px;color:#667085;font-weight:800">TOTAL BOOKING VALUE</div><div class="ticket-total" id="ticketTotal">₹0</div></div><div class="pro-actions"><button class="ts-btn secondary" onclick="printTicket()">🖨 Print</button><button class="ts-btn purple" onclick="downloadTicketHtml()">⬇ Save Ticket</button></div></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- =========================================================
     NOTIFICATION PANEL
========================================================= -->
<div id="notifyOverlay" class="quick-overlay" onclick="closeNotificationsOnBackdrop(event)">
  <div class="notify-panel">
    <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center"><div><div class="pro-nav-badge">🔔 TICKETSAFE ALERTS</div><h2 style="font:800 24px Manrope;margin-top:7px">Notification Center</h2></div><button class="ticket-close" style="background:#f2f4f7;color:#344054" onclick="closeNotifications()">×</button></div>
    <div id="notificationList" style="margin-top:12px"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- PROFILE PAGE -->
<section id="profilePage" class="pro-shell" style="display:none">
  <div class="pro-top"><div><div class="pro-nav-badge">👤 MY PROFILE</div><h1>Account & Preferences</h1><p>Manage your TicketSafe demo account and booking activity.</p></div><button class="ts-btn secondary" onclick="showHome()">← Back Home</button></div>
  <div class="pro-card"><div id="profilePageContent"></div></div>
</section>

<footer>
    <p>© 2026 TicketSafe — Concurrency Safe Ticket Booking System &nbsp;•&nbsp; Simple Booking Demo &nbsp;•&nbsp; 8+ Categories</p>
</footer>

/* =========================================================

========================================================= */



function generateDailyDates(days = 30) {
  const dates = [];
  const today = new Date();
  today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

  for (let i = 0; i < days; i++) {
    const d = new Date(today);
    d.setDate(today.getDate() + i);
    const value = d.toISOString().split("T")[0];
    const label = d.toLocaleDateString("en-IN", {
      weekday: "short",
      day: "2-digit",
      month: "short",
      year: "numeric"
    });
    dates.push({ value, label });
  }

  return dates;
}

const eventDates = generateDailyDates(30);



events.forEach(item => {
  item.showTimes = ["6:00 PM - 11:00 PM"];
  item.time = item.showTimes[0];
  item.dates = eventDates;
  item.date = eventDates[0].value;
});

function changeCategory(category, button) {

    currentCategory = category;

    document.querySelectorAll(".category").forEach(btn => {
        btn.classList.remove("active");
    });

    button.classList.add("active");

    if (
        category === "bus" ||
        category === "train" ||
        category === "flight"
    ) {

        document.getElementById("travelSearch").style.display = "grid";

        if (category === "bus") {
            currentResults = buses;
            document.getElementById("resultTitle").innerHTML =
                "🚌 Available Bus";
        }

        if (category === "train") {
            currentResults = trains;
            document.getElementById("resultTitle").innerHTML =
                "🚆 Available Train";
        }

        if (category === "flight") {
            currentResults = flights;
            document.getElementById("resultTitle").innerHTML =
                "✈️ Available Flight";
        }

        displayResults(currentResults);

    } else {

        document.getElementById("travelSearch").style.display = "none";

        if (category === "movie") {
            currentResults = movies;
            document.getElementById("resultTitle").innerHTML =
                "🎬 Available Movies";
        }

        if (category === "event") {
            currentResults = events;
            document.getElementById("resultTitle").innerHTML =
                "🎉 Available Events";
        }

        if (category === "podcast") {
            currentResults = podcasts;
            document.getElementById("resultTitle").innerHTML =
                "🎙️ Available Podcasts";
        }

        displayResults(currentResults);
    }
}

/* =========================================================
   DISPLAY CARDS
========================================================= */

function displayResults(data) {

    const results = document.getElementById("results");

    results.innerHTML = "";

    if (data.length === 0) {

        results.innerHTML = `
            <div style="
                grid-column:1/-1;
                background:white;
                padding:40px;
                border-radius:15px;
                text-align:center;
            ">
                <h2>No services found</h2>
            </div>
        `;

        return;
    }

    const renderedCategory = currentCategory;

    data.forEach((item, index) => {

        let routeHTML = "";

        if (
            currentCategory === "bus" ||
            currentCategory === "train" ||
            currentCategory === "flight"
        ) {

            routeHTML = `
                <div class="info">
                    📍 ${item.from} → ${item.to}
                </div>
            `;

        } else {

            routeHTML = `
                <div class="info">
                    📍 ${item.location}
                </div>
            `;

        }

        const card = document.createElement("div");

        card.className = "card";

        card.innerHTML = `

            <div class="card-top">
                <img src="${photoFor(currentCategory)}" alt="${currentCategory} transport">
            </div>

            <div class="card-content">

                <h3>${item.name}</h3>

                ${routeHTML}

                ${
                    currentCategory === "event"
                    ? `
                    <div class="info showtime-box">
                        📅 <strong>Event Date</strong>
                        <select
                            class="showtime-select"
                            id="eventdate-${index}"
                            onchange="updateEventDate(${index}, this.value)"
                        >
                            ${item.dates.map(d =>
                                `<option value="${d.value}" ${d.value === item.date ? "selected" : ""}>${d.label}</option>`
                            ).join("")}
                        </select>
                    </div>
                    <div class="info">
                        🕒 <strong>Time:</strong> ${item.time}
                    </div>
                    `
                    : (currentCategory === "movie" || currentCategory === "podcast")
                    ? `
                    ${currentCategory === "movie" ? `<div class="info">🎬 <strong>${item.screen}</strong></div>` : ""}
                    ${currentCategory === "podcast" ? `<div class="info">🎙️ <strong>${item.screen}</strong></div>` : ""}
                    <div class="info">
                        🕒 <strong>Time:</strong> ${item.time}
                    </div>
                    `
                    : `
                    <div class="info">
                        🕒 <strong>${currentCategory === "cricket" || currentCategory === "kabaddi" ? "Entry Time:" : ""}</strong> ${item.time}
                    </div>
                    `
                }

                <div class="price-row">

                    <div class="price movie-card-price"></div>

                    <button
                        class="book-btn"
                        onclick="bookResult(${index}, '${renderedCategory}')"
                    >
                        Book Now
                    </button>

                </div>

            </div>
        `;

        results.appendChild(card);

    });
}



function updateEntertainmentTime(index, time) {
    if (
        currentCategory === "movie" ||
        currentCategory === "podcast"
    ) {
        currentResults[index].time = time;
    }
}

function updateEventDate(index, date) {
    if (currentCategory === "event") {
        currentResults[index].date = date;
    }
}

function bookResult(index, category) {
    const data =
        category === "bus" ? buses :
        category === "train" ? trains :
        category === "flight" ? flights :
        category === "movie" ? movies :
        category === "event" ? events :
        category === "podcast" ? podcasts :
        category === "cricket" ? cricket :
        category === "kabaddi" ? kabaddi : [];

    const service = data[index];

    if (!service) {
        alert("Unable to open this booking. Please select the service again.");
        return;
    }

    // Keep the seating screen tied to the category that was clicked.
    currentCategory = category;
    currentResults = data;
    startBooking({ ...service, category: category });
}

function bookEntertainment(index) {
    const service = { ...currentResults[index] };

    const eventDateSelector = document.getElementById("eventdate-" + index);
    if (eventDateSelector) {
        service.date = eventDateSelector.value;
    }

    // Movie/podcast time is fixed from the movie data; no time-slot dropdown.
    startBooking(service);
}

/* =========================================================
   START BOOKING
========================================================= */

function startBooking(service, categoryOverride) {

    // Keep the exact category with the selected booking.
    if (categoryOverride) {
        currentCategory = categoryOverride;
    } else if (service && service.category) {
        currentCategory = service.category;
    }

    selectedService = { ...service, category: currentCategory };
    selectedSeats = [];
    updateTravelerLabels();

    document.getElementById("bookingSection").style.display = "block";

    document.getElementById("bookingSection").scrollIntoView({
        behavior: "smooth"
    });

    document.getElementById("bookingTitle").innerText =
        service.name;

    if (service.from) {

        document.getElementById("bookingRoute").innerText =
            `${service.from} → ${service.to} | ${service.time}`;

    } else {

        const eventDateText =
            (currentCategory === "event" && service.date)
                ? new Date(service.date + "T00:00:00").toLocaleDateString("en-IN", {
                    weekday: "long",
                    day: "2-digit",
                    month: "long",
                    year: "numeric"
                })
                : null;

        const displayTimeText =
            (currentCategory === "cricket" || currentCategory === "kabaddi")
                ? `Entry Time: ${service.entryTime || service.time}`
                : service.time;

        document.getElementById("bookingRoute").innerText =
            eventDateText
                ? `${service.location} | ${eventDateText} | ${displayTimeText}`
                : `${service.location} | ${displayTimeText}`;

    }

    const bookingScreenLabel = document.getElementById("bookingScreenLabel");
    if (bookingScreenLabel) {
        bookingScreenLabel.textContent =
            currentCategory === "cricket"
                ? "STADIUM STANDS / SEATING"
                : currentCategory === "kabaddi"
                    ? "INDOOR ARENA / SEATING"
                    : currentCategory === "bus"
                        ? "BUS SEATING — ROW A"
                        : currentCategory === "train"
                            ? "TRAIN SEATING — ROW B"
                            : currentCategory === "flight"
                                ? "FLIGHT SEATING — ROW C"
                                : currentCategory === "movie"
                                    ? `MOVIE THEATRE — ${service.screen ? service.screen.toUpperCase() : ""}`
                                    : currentCategory === "event"
                                        ? "EVENT VENUE"
                                        : currentCategory === "podcast"
                                            ? "PODCAST VENUE"
                                            : "SEAT / SCREEN / COACH";
        bookingScreenLabel.style.display =
            (currentCategory === "cricket" || currentCategory === "kabaddi")
                ? "none"
                : "block";
    }

    createSeats();

    createPassengerForms();

    startTimer();

}


/* =========================================================
   CREATE 200 SEATS (50 PER STAND)
========================================================= */

function entertainmentSeatLabel(number) {
    // Displayed Third Class: original first block (12 rows x 16)
    if (number <= 192) {
        const row = Math.floor((number - 1) / 16);
        const seat = ((number - 1) % 16) + 1;
        return "T-" + String.fromCharCode(65 + row) + seat;
    }

    // Displayed Second Class: middle block (3 rows x 16)
    if (number <= 240) {
        const local = number - 193;
        const row = Math.floor(local / 16);
        const seat = (local % 16) + 1;
        return "S-" + String.fromCharCode(65 + row) + seat;
    }

    // Displayed First Class: original third block (3 rows x 16)
    const local = number - 241;
    const row = Math.floor(local / 16);
    const seat = (local % 16) + 1;
    return "F-" + String.fromCharCode(65 + row) + seat;
}

function seatLabel(number) {
    if (currentCategory === "cricket" || currentCategory === "kabaddi") {
        if (number <= 50) return "C" + number;
        if (number <= 100) return "B" + (number - 50);
        if (number <= 150) return "A" + (number - 100);
        return "D" + (number - 150);
    }

    if (currentCategory === "bus") {
        const busRow = Math.floor((number - 1) / 3) + 1;
        const busCol = ["A","B","C"][(number - 1) % 3];
        return busRow + busCol;
    }
    if (currentCategory === "train") {
        const trainRow = Math.floor((number - 1) / 4) + 1;
        const trainCol = ["A","B","C","D"][(number - 1) % 4];
        return trainRow + trainCol;
    }
    if (currentCategory === "flight") {
        const flightRow = Math.floor((number - 1) / 6) + 1;
        const flightCol = ["A","B","C","D","E","F"][(number - 1) % 6];
        return flightRow + flightCol;
    }

    if (currentCategory === "movie" || currentCategory === "event" || currentCategory === "podcast") {
        return entertainmentSeatLabel(number);
    }

    return "S" + number;
}
