            wrap.appendChild(label);
            for (let col=0; col<3; col++) {
                wrap.appendChild(makeTransportSeat(number++, bookedSeats, "flight-seat"));
            }
            const aisle = document.createElement("div");
            aisle.className = "flight-aisle";
            wrap.appendChild(aisle);
            for (let col=0; col<3; col++) {
                wrap.appendChild(makeTransportSeat(number++, bookedSeats, "flight-seat"));
            }
            rows.appendChild(wrap);
        }
        return;
    }

    if (currentCategory === "movie" || currentCategory === "event" || currentCategory === "podcast") {
        container.className = "seats entertainment-seats";

        const isMovie = currentCategory === "movie";
        const isEvent = currentCategory === "event";
        const isPodcast = currentCategory === "podcast";
        const defaultPrice = selectedService && selectedService.price
            ? Number(selectedService.price)
            : 0;

        // Movie prices: First ₹100, Second ₹200, Third ₹300.
        // Event prices: First ₹799, Second ₹599, Third ₹399.
        // Podcast prices: First ₹399, Second ₹599, Third ₹799.
        const sections = isMovie
            ? [
                { title: "Third Class", rows: 12, start: 1, price: 300 },
                { title: "Second Class", rows: 3, start: 193, price: 200 },
                { title: "First Class", rows: 3, start: 241, price: 100 }
              ]
            : isEvent
                ? [
                    { title: "Third Class", rows: 12, start: 1, price: 399 },
                    { title: "Second Class", rows: 3, start: 193, price: 599 },
                    { title: "First Class", rows: 3, start: 241, price: 799 }
                  ]
                : isPodcast
                    ? [
                        { title: "Third Class", rows: 12, start: 1, price: 799 },
                        { title: "Second Class", rows: 3, start: 193, price: 599 },
                        { title: "First Class", rows: 3, start: 241, price: 399 }
                      ]
                    : [
                        { title: "Third Class", rows: 12, start: 1, price: defaultPrice },
                        { title: "Second Class", rows: 3, start: 193, price: defaultPrice },
                        { title: "First Class", rows: 3, start: 241, price: defaultPrice }
                      ];

        sections.forEach((section, sectionIndex) => {
            const sectionEl = document.createElement("div");
            sectionEl.className = "cinema-class-section";
            sectionEl.innerHTML =
                `<div class="cinema-class-title"><strong>${section.title}</strong> <span>₹${section.price} / seat</span></div>`;

            for (let row = 0; row < section.rows; row++) {
                const rowWrap = document.createElement("div");
                rowWrap.className = "cinema-seat-row";

                const label = document.createElement("div");
                label.className = "cinema-row-label";
                label.textContent = String.fromCharCode(65 + row);

                const rowSeats = document.createElement("div");
                rowSeats.className = "cinema-row-seats";

                for (let col = 1; col <= 16; col++) {
                    const number = section.start + row * 16 + col - 1;
                    rowSeats.appendChild(makeEntertainmentSeat(number, bookedSeats));
                }

                rowWrap.appendChild(label);
                rowWrap.appendChild(rowSeats);
                sectionEl.appendChild(rowWrap);
            }

            container.appendChild(sectionEl);

            // Movie screen below First Class.
            if (sectionIndex === 2 && isMovie) {
                const screen = document.createElement("div");
                screen.className = "cinema-screen";
                screen.innerHTML = `<span>${selectedService && selectedService.screen ? selectedService.screen.toUpperCase() : "MOVIE SCREEN"}</span>`;
                container.appendChild(screen);
            }

            // Event stage/screen below First Class.
            if (sectionIndex === 2 && isEvent) {
                const stage = document.createElement("div");
                stage.className = "cinema-screen";
                stage.innerHTML = `<span>STAGE / SCREEN</span>`;
                container.appendChild(stage);
            }

            // Podcast screen below First Class.
            if (sectionIndex === 2 && isPodcast) {
                const screen = document.createElement("div");
                screen.className = "cinema-screen";
                screen.innerHTML = `<span>${selectedService && selectedService.screen ? selectedService.screen.toUpperCase() : "PODCAST SCREEN"}</span>`;
                container.appendChild(screen);
            }
        });
        return;
    }

    container.className = "seats";
    for (let i=1;i<=40;i++) container.appendChild(makeSportsSeat(i,bookedSeats));
}


function makeTransportSeat(number, bookedSeats, extraClass) {
    const seat = document.createElement("button");
    seat.className = "seat transport-seat " + extraClass + " available";
    seat.id = "seat-" + number;
    seat.textContent = seatLabel(number);
    seat.setAttribute("aria-label", "Seat " + seatLabel(number));
    seat.title = seatLabel(number);

    if (bookedSeats.includes(number)) {
        seat.classList.remove("available");
        seat.classList.add("booked");
        seat.disabled = true;
    } else {
        seat.onclick = function() {
            toggleSeat(number);
        };
    }
    return seat;
}

function makeEntertainmentSeat(number, bookedSeats) {
    const seat = document.createElement("button");
    seat.className = "seat";
    seat.id = "seat-" + number;
    seat.setAttribute("aria-label", "Seat " + seatLabel(number));
    seat.title = seatLabel(number);

    if (bookedSeats.includes(number)) {
        seat.classList.add("booked");
        seat.disabled = true;
    } else {
        seat.onclick = function() { toggleSeat(number); };
    }
    return seat;
}

function makeSportsSeat(number, bookedSeats) {
    const seat = document.createElement("button");
    seat.className = "seat";
    seat.id = "seat-" + number;
    seat.textContent = seatLabel(number);

    if (bookedSeats.includes(number)) {
        seat.classList.add("booked");
        seat.disabled = true;
    } else {
        seat.onclick = function() {
            toggleSeat(number);
        };
    }

    return seat;
}


/* =========================================================
   SELECT / DESELECT SEAT
   MAXIMUM 6
========================================================= */

function toggleSeat(number) {

    const seat = document.getElementById("seat-" + number);

    if (selectedSeats.includes(number)) {

        selectedSeats = selectedSeats.filter(
            seatNumber => seatNumber !== number
        );

        seat.classList.remove("selected");

    } else {

        if (selectedSeats.length >= MAX_SEATS) {

            alert("You can select a maximum of 6 seats.");

            return;
        }

        selectedSeats.push(number);

        seat.classList.add("selected");
    }

    selectedSeats.sort((a,b) => a-b);

    document.getElementById("selectedCount").textContent =
        selectedSeats.length;

    createPassengerForms();
}


/* =========================================================
   PASSENGER FORMS
   ONE NAME + PHONE + GENDER FOR EACH SEAT
========================================================= */

function getTravelerLabel() {
    // Only transport categories use the word Passenger.
    // Every entertainment/sports category always uses Person.
    const category = String(currentCategory || "").toLowerCase();
    const passengerCategories = ["bus", "train", "flight"];
    return passengerCategories.includes(category) ? "Passenger" : "Person";
}

function updateTravelerLabels() {
    const label = getTravelerLabel();
    const plural = label === "Passenger" ? "passengers" : "persons";

    const title = document.getElementById("travelerDetailsTitle");
    const text = document.getElementById("travelerDetailsText");

    if (title) title.textContent = `${label} Details`;
    if (text) text.textContent = `Enter one ${label.toLowerCase()} for every selected seat. Maximum 6 ${plural}.`;
}

function createPassengerForms() {

    const container =
        document.getElementById("passengerContainer");

    container.innerHTML = "";
    updateTravelerLabels();

    selectedSeats.forEach((seatNumber, index) => {

        const passenger = document.createElement("div");

        passenger.className = "passenger";

        passenger.innerHTML = `

            <div class="passenger-heading">
                <h3>
                    ${getTravelerLabel()} ${index + 1}
                    — Seat ${seatLabel(seatNumber)}
                </h3>

                <button
                    type="button"
                    class="remove-passenger-btn"
                    onclick="removePassengerSeat(${seatNumber})"
                >
                    ✕ Remove ${getTravelerLabel()}
                </button>
            </div>

            <div class="passenger-grid">

                <input
                    type="text"
                    id="name-${seatNumber}"
                    placeholder="Name"
                >

                <input
                    type="tel"
                    id="phone-${seatNumber}"
                    placeholder="Phone Number"
                    maxlength="10"
                >

                <select id="gender-${seatNumber}">

                    <option value="">
                        Select Gender
                    </option>

                    <option value="Male">
                        Male
                    </option>

                    <option value="Female">
                        Female
                    </option>

                    <option value="Other">
                        Other
                    </option>

                </select>

            </div>
        `;

        container.appendChild(passenger);

    });

}

function removePassengerSeat(seatNumber) {

    selectedSeats = selectedSeats.filter(
        seat => seat !== seatNumber
    );

    const seatButton = document.getElementById("seat-" + seatNumber);

    if (seatButton) {
        seatButton.classList.remove("selected");
    }

    selectedSeats.sort((a, b) => a - b);

    document.getElementById("selectedCount").textContent =
        selectedSeats.length;

    createPassengerForms();
}


/* =========================================================
   TIMER
========================================================= */

function startTimer() {

    clearInterval(timerInterval);

    timerSeconds = 300;

    updateTimer();

    timerInterval = setInterval(() => {

        timerSeconds--;

        updateTimer();

        if (timerSeconds <= 0) {

            clearInterval(timerInterval);

            alert(
                "Your booking session has expired. Please select the seats again."
            );

            selectedSeats = [];

            createSeats();

            createPassengerForms();

        }

    }, 1000);

}


function updateTimer() {

    const minutes =
        Math.floor(timerSeconds / 60)
        .toString()
        .padStart(2, "0");

    const seconds =
        (timerSeconds % 60)
        .toString()
        .padStart(2, "0");

    document.getElementById("timer").innerHTML =
        `⏱️ ${minutes}:${seconds}`;

}


/* =========================================================
   CONCURRENCY-SAFE FRONTEND BOOKING
========================================================= */

function acquireBookingLock() {

    const lockKey = "ticketsafe_booking_lock";

    const now = Date.now();

    const existingLock =
        localStorage.getItem(lockKey);

    if (existingLock) {

        const lockTime =
            parseInt(existingLock);

        /*
         * Lock expires after 15 seconds.
         * This prevents a stale browser lock.
         */

        if (now - lockTime < 15000) {

            return false;

        }

    }

    localStorage.setItem(lockKey, now.toString());

    return true;
}


function releaseBookingLock() {

    localStorage.removeItem(
        "ticketsafe_booking_lock"
    );

}


/* =========================================================
   CONFIRM BOOKING
========================================================= */

function confirmBooking() {
    if (selectedSeats.length === 0) {
        alert("Please select at least one seat.");
        return;
    }

    if (selectedSeats.length > MAX_SEATS) {
        alert("Maximum 6 seats can be booked.");
        return;
    }

    if (!acquireBookingLock()) {
        alert("Another booking is currently being processed. Please try again.");
        return;
    }

    const passengers = [];
    let valid = true;

    selectedSeats.forEach(seatNumber => {
        const nameEl = document.getElementById("name-" + seatNumber);
        const phoneEl = document.getElementById("phone-" + seatNumber);
        const genderEl = document.getElementById("gender-" + seatNumber);

        const name = nameEl ? nameEl.value.trim() : "";
        const phone = phoneEl ? phoneEl.value.trim() : "";
        const gender = genderEl ? genderEl.value : "";

        if (!name || !phone || !gender || !/^[0-9]{10}$/.test(phone)) {
            valid = false;
            return;
        }

        passengers.push({
            seat: seatLabel(seatNumber),
            name,
            phone,
            gender
        });
    });

    if (!valid) {
        releaseBookingLock();
        alert("Please enter valid Name, 10-digit Phone Number and Gender for every selected seat.");
        return;
    }

    const booking = {
        bookingId: "TS" + Date.now(),
        service: selectedService.name,
        category: currentCategory,
        route: selectedService.from
            ? `${selectedService.from} → ${selectedService.to}`
            : selectedService.location,
        seats: selectedSeats.map(seat => seatLabel(seat)),
        time: selectedService.time,
        date: selectedService.date || null,
        passengers,
        total: currentCategory === "movie"
            ? selectedSeats.reduce((sum, seat) => {
                if (seat <= 192) return sum + 300;
                if (seat <= 240) return sum + 200;
                return sum + 100;
              }, 0)
            : currentCategory === "event"
                ? selectedSeats.reduce((sum, seat) => {
                    if (seat <= 192) return sum + 399;
                    if (seat <= 240) return sum + 599;
                    return sum + 799;
                  }, 0)
                : currentCategory === "podcast"
                    ? selectedSeats.reduce((sum, seat) => {
                        if (seat <= 192) return sum + 799;
                        if (seat <= 240) return sum + 599;
                        return sum + 399;
                      }, 0)
                    : selectedSeats.length * Number(selectedService.price || 0),
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        bookingStatus: "CONFIRMED"
    };

    // Save the booking immediately.
    const bookings = getSavedBookings();
    bookings.push(booking);
    localStorage.setItem("ticketsafe_bookings", JSON.stringify(bookings));

    releaseBookingLock();

    document.getElementById("successText").innerHTML =
        `<strong>Booking Status:</strong> Confirmed<br><br>` +
        `<strong>Booking ID:</strong> ${escapeBookingText(booking.bookingId)}<br><br>` +
        `<strong>Service:</strong> ${escapeBookingText(booking.service)}<br><br>` +
        `<strong>Show / Travel Time:</strong> ${escapeBookingText(booking.time || "—")}<br><br>` +
        `<strong>Seats:</strong> ${escapeBookingText(booking.seats.join(", "))}<br><br>` +
        `<strong>Persons:</strong> ${booking.passengers.length}<br><br>` +
        `<strong>Total:</strong> ₹${Number(booking.total).toLocaleString("en-IN")}`;

    document.getElementById("successBox").style.display = "block";
    document.getElementById("successBox").scrollIntoView({
        behavior: "smooth",
        block: "center"
    });
}


/* =========================================================
   INITIAL LOAD
========================================================= */

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {

    /*
     * Load bus locations initially.
     */

    loadLocations();

    displayResults(buses);

});

</script>

<script>
function photoFor(cat){if(cat==='bus')return 'data:image/png;base64,';if(cat==='train')return 'data:image/png;base64,';if(cat==='flight')return 'data:image/png;base64,';return '';}

function renderPopular(){
  const el=document.getElementById('popularResults');
  if(!el) return;

  const items = [
    ...(buses.slice(0,1).map(x=>({...x, category:'bus'}))),
    ...(trains.slice(0,1).map(x=>({...x, category:'train'}))),
    ...(flights.slice(0,1).map(x=>({...x, category:'flight'})))
  ];

  el.innerHTML = items.map(item => `
    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-top">
        <img src="${photoFor(item.category)}" alt="${item.category}">
        <span class="card-badge">${item.category.toUpperCase()}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="card-content">
        <h3>${item.name}</h3>
        <div class="info">📍 ${item.from} → ${item.to}</div>
        <div class="info">🕒 ${item.time}</div>
        <div class="price-row">
          <div class="price">₹${item.price}</div>
          <button class="book-btn" onclick='startBooking(${JSON.stringify(item)})'>Book Now</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  `).join('');
}

function showPopular(){
  document.getElementById('activeBlock').style.display='none';
  document.getElementById('popularBlock').style.display='block';
  document.getElementById('explore').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'});
}

renderPopular();



function showAllCategory(category){
  const buttonIndex = category==='bus' ? 0 : category==='train' ? 1 : 2;
  const button = document.querySelectorAll('.category')[buttonIndex];

  document.querySelectorAll('.category').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('active'));
  if(button) button.classList.add('active');

  currentCategory = category;
  currentResults = dataForCategory(category);

  loadLocations();

  document.getElementById('popularBlock').style.display='none';
  document.getElementById('activeBlock').style.display='block';

  document.getElementById('resultTitle').textContent =
    category==='bus' ? 'Available Bus Routes' :
    category==='train' ? 'Available Train Routes' :
    'Available Flight Routes';

  displayResults(currentResults);
  document.getElementById('explore').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'});
}

const _baseChangeCategory = changeCategory;
changeCategory = function(category, button) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.category').forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('active'));
    if (button) button.classList.add('active');

    currentCategory = category;
    currentResults = category === 'bus' ? buses : category === 'train' ? trains : flights;

    loadLocations();

    document.getElementById('myBookings').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('bookingSection').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('homeNav').classList.add('nav-active');
    document.getElementById('bookingsNav').classList.remove('nav-active');
    document.getElementById('popularBlock').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('activeBlock').style.display = 'block';

    document.getElementById('resultTitle').textContent =
        category === 'bus' ? '🚌 Available Bus Routes' :
        category === 'train' ? '🚆 Available Train Routes' :
        '✈️ Available Flight Routes';

    displayResults(currentResults);
    document.getElementById('explore').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'start'});
};

/* =========================================================
   MY BOOKINGS
   Bookings are already stored in localStorage by confirmBooking().
========================================================= */
function getSavedBookings() {
    try {
        return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('ticketsafe_bookings') || '[]');
    } catch (error) {
        return [];
    }
}

function hideInfoPages() {
    ['offers','help','about'].forEach(id => {
        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.style.display = 'none';
    });
}

function resetNavActive() {
    ['homeNav','bookingsNav','offersNav','helpNav','aboutNav'].forEach(id => {
        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.classList.remove('nav-active');
    });
}

function showInfoPage(page) {
    hideInfoPages();
    document.getElementById('myBookings').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('bookingSection').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('popularBlock').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('activeBlock').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('explore').style.display = 'none';
    document.querySelector('.booking-box').style.display = 'none';
    document.querySelector('.hero').style.display = 'none';

    const section = document.getElementById(page);
    if (!section) return;
    section.style.display = 'block';
    resetNavActive();
    const nav = document.getElementById(page + 'Nav');
    if (nav) nav.classList.add('nav-active');
    section.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'start'});
}

function showMyBookings() {
    hideInfoPages();
    document.querySelector('.hero').style.display = 'none';
    document.querySelector('.booking-box').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('popularBlock').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('activeBlock').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('bookingSection').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('explore').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('myBookings').style.display = 'block';

    resetNavActive();
    document.getElementById('bookingsNav').classList.add('nav-active');

    renderMyBookings();
    document.getElementById('myBookings').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'start'});
}

function showHome() {
    hideInfoPages();
    document.querySelector('.hero').style.display = 'block';
    document.querySelector('.booking-box').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('myBookings').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('bookingSection').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('activeBlock').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('popularBlock').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('explore').style.display = 'block';

    resetNavActive();
    document.getElementById('homeNav').classList.add('nav-active');

    window.scrollTo({top:0, behavior:'smooth'});
}

function renderMyBookings() {
    const list = document.getElementById('myBookingsList');
    if (!list) return;
    const bookings = getSavedBookings().slice();
    const q = (document.getElementById('tsBookingSearch')?.value || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    const sort = document.getElementById('tsBookingSort')?.value || 'latest';
    const status = window.__tsBookingStatus || 'all';
    let filtered = bookings.filter(b => {
      const hay = [b.bookingId,b.service,b.category,b.route,(b.seats||[]).join(' ')].join(' ').toLowerCase();
      const st = b.bookingStatus || 'CONFIRMED';
      return (!q || hay.includes(q)) && (status === 'all' || st === status);
    });
    filtered.sort((a,b)=>{
      if(sort==='oldest') return new Date(a.createdAt||0)-new Date(b.createdAt||0);
      if(sort==='amountHigh') return Number(b.total||0)-Number(a.total||0);
      if(sort==='amountLow') return Number(a.total||0)-Number(b.total||0);
      return new Date(b.createdAt||0)-new Date(a.createdAt||0);
    });
    if (!filtered.length) { list.innerHTML='<div class="empty-bookings"><h3>No matching bookings</h3><p>Try another search or filter.</p></div>'; return; }
    list.innerHTML = filtered.map(booking => {
      const date = booking.createdAt ? new Date(booking.createdAt).toLocaleString() : '—';
      const seats = Array.isArray(booking.seats) ? booking.seats.join(', ') : '—';
      const passengerCount = Array.isArray(booking.passengers) ? booking.passengers.length : (booking.passengers || 0);
      const category = (booking.category || 'ticket').toUpperCase();
      const cancelled = booking.bookingStatus === 'CANCELLED';
      return `<article class="booking-card"><span class="booking-status">${cancelled?'CANCELLED':'BOOKED'} • ${category}</span><h3>${escapeBookingText(booking.service || 'Ticket')}</h3><div class="booking-meta"><strong>Name:</strong> ${escapeBookingText(Array.isArray(booking.passengers)?booking.passengers.map(p=>p.name).filter(Boolean).join(', ')||'—':'—')}<br><strong>Phone Number:</strong> ${escapeBookingText(Array.isArray(booking.passengers)?booking.passengers.map(p=>p.phone).filter(Boolean).join(', ')||'—':'—')}<br><strong>Booking ID:</strong> ${escapeBookingText(booking.bookingId || '—')}<br><strong>Route:</strong> ${escapeBookingText(booking.route || '—')}<br><strong>Seats:</strong> ${escapeBookingText(seats)}<br><strong>${['bus','train','flight'].includes(booking.category)?'Passengers':'Persons'}:</strong> ${passengerCount}<br><strong>Booked on:</strong> ${escapeBookingText(date)}</div><div class="booking-total">Total: ₹${Number(booking.total||0).toLocaleString('en-IN')}</div><div class="quick-ticket-actions"><button class="primary" onclick="openTicketById('${escapeBookingText(booking.bookingId||'')}')">🎟 View Ticket</button><button onclick="printAdminTicket('${escapeBookingText(booking.bookingId||'')}')">🖨 Print</button>${!cancelled?`<button onclick="cancelTicket('${escapeBookingText(booking.bookingId||'')}')">✕ Cancel</button>`:''}</div></article>`;
    }).join('');
}
function filterTSBookings(){renderMyBookings()}
function setTSBookingStatus(status,btn){window.__tsBookingStatus=status;document.querySelectorAll('.booking-filter-tabs button').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('active'));if(btn)btn.classList.add('active');renderMyBookings()}
function clearTSBookingFilter(){const q=document.getElementById('tsBookingSearch'),s=document.getElementById('tsBookingSort');if(q)q.value='';if(s)s.value='latest';window.__tsBookingStatus='all';document.querySelectorAll('.booking-filter-tabs button').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('active',x.dataset.tsStatus==='all'));renderMyBookings()}

function escapeBookingText(value) {
    return String(value)
        .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
        .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
        .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
        .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
        .replace(/'/g, '&#039;');
}

// Make sure the home page starts in its normal state.
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    document.getElementById('myBookings').style.display = 'none';
    hideInfoPages();
});

</script>

<script>
/* Exact user-supplied category photos */
function photoFor(cat) {
  if (cat === 'movie') return 'data:image/png;base64,';
  if (cat === 'event') return 'data:image/png;base64,';
  if (cat === 'podcast') return 'data:image/png;base64,';
  if (cat === 'cricket') return 'data:image/png;base64,';
  if (cat === 'kabaddi') return 'data:image/png;base64,';
  if (cat === 'bus') return window.__ticketSafeBusPhoto || '';
  if (cat === 'train') return window.__ticketSafeTrainPhoto || '';
  if (cat === 'flight') return window.__ticketSafeFlightPhoto || '';
  return '';
}

<script>
/* FINAL CATEGORY HANDLER - keeps the existing design/photos and adds all requested categories. */
(function () {
  function categoryData(category) {
    return category === 'bus' ? buses :
           category === 'train' ? trains :
           category === 'flight' ? flights :
           category === 'movie' ? movies :
           category === 'event' ? events :
           category === 'podcast' ? podcasts :
           category === 'cricket' ? cricket :
           category === 'kabaddi' ? kabaddi : [];
  }

  window.changeCategory = function(category, button) {
    currentCategory = category;
    currentResults = categoryData(category);

    document.querySelectorAll('.category').forEach(function(btn) {
      btn.classList.remove('active');
    });
    if (button) button.classList.add('active');

    var travelSearch = document.getElementById('travelSearch');
    var popularBlock = document.getElementById('popularBlock');
    var activeBlock = document.getElementById('activeBlock');
    var bookingSection = document.getElementById('bookingSection');
    var myBookings = document.getElementById('myBookings');
    var title = document.getElementById('resultTitle');

    if (travelSearch) {
      travelSearch.style.display = ['bus','train','flight'].includes(category) ? 'grid' : 'none';
    }
    if (popularBlock) popularBlock.style.display = 'none';
    if (activeBlock) activeBlock.style.display = 'block';
    if (bookingSection) bookingSection.style.display = 'none';
    if (myBookings) myBookings.style.display = 'none';

    if (['bus','train','flight'].includes(category)) {
      loadLocations();
    }

    var titles = {
      bus: '🚌 Available Bus Routes',
      train: '🚆 Available Train Routes',
      flight: '✈️ Available Flight Routes',
      movie: '🎬 Available Movies',
      event: '🎉 Available Events',
      podcast: '🎙️ Available Podcasts',
      cricket: '🏏 Available Cricket Stadiums',
      kabaddi: '🤼 Available Kabaddi Stadiums'
    };
    if (title) title.textContent = titles[category] || 'Available Services';

    displayResults(currentResults);
    var explore = document.getElementById('explore');
    if (explore) explore.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'start'});
  };

  window.showAllCategory = function(category) {
    var buttons = document.querySelectorAll('.category');
    var indexes = {bus:0, train:1, flight:2, movie:3, event:4, podcast:5, cricket:6, kabaddi:7};
    var btn = buttons[indexes[category]];
    window.changeCategory(category, btn);
  };

  window.showPopular = function() {
    document.getElementById('activeBlock').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('popularBlock').style.display = 'block';
  };
})();
</script>

@media(max-width:900px){.offer-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.two-col-info{grid-template-columns:1fr}.contact-cards{grid-template-columns:1fr}.about-card{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:14px}}

<script>
/* TicketSafe Login / Signup */
let authMode = 'login';

function openAuthModal(mode='login') {
  switchAuthMode(mode);
  const modal = document.getElementById('authModal');
  modal.style.display = 'flex';
  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
  setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('authEmail').focus(), 50);
}
function closeAuthModal() {
  document.getElementById('authModal').style.display = 'none';
  document.body.style.overflow = '';
}
function closeAuthOnBackdrop(event) {
  if (event.target.id === 'authModal') closeAuthModal();
}
function switchAuthMode(mode) {
  authMode = mode;
  const signup = mode === 'signup';
  document.getElementById('loginTab').classList.toggle('active', !signup);
  document.getElementById('signupTab').classList.toggle('active', signup);
  document.getElementById('nameField').style.display = signup ? 'block' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('confirmPasswordField').style.display = signup ? 'block' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('authTitle').textContent = signup ? 'Create your account' : 'Welcome back';
  document.getElementById('authSubtitle').textContent = signup ? 'Sign up to manage your TicketSafe bookings.' : 'Login to manage your bookings.';
  document.getElementById('authSubmit').textContent = signup ? 'Create Account' : 'Login';
  document.getElementById('authMessage').textContent = '';
}
function getTicketSafeUsers(){
  try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('ticketsafe_users') || '[]'); } catch(e) { return []; }
}
function handleAuth(event) {
  event.preventDefault();
  const name = document.getElementById('authName').value.trim();
  const email = document.getElementById('authEmail').value.trim().toLowerCase();
  const password = document.getElementById('authPassword').value;
  const confirm = document.getElementById('authConfirmPassword').value;
  const message = document.getElementById('authMessage');
  let users = getTicketSafeUsers();

  if (authMode === 'signup') {
    if (!name) { message.textContent = 'Please enter your name.'; return; }
    if (password !== confirm) { message.textContent = 'Passwords do not match.'; return; }
    if (users.some(u => u.email === email)) { message.textContent = 'Account already exists. Please login.'; return; }
    users.push({name, email, password});
    localStorage.setItem('ticketsafe_users', JSON.stringify(users));
    localStorage.setItem('ticketsafe_current_user', JSON.stringify({name,email}));
    message.textContent = 'Account created successfully!';
    setTimeout(() => { closeAuthModal(); updateAuthButton(); }, 650);
  } else {
    const user = users.find(u => u.email === email && u.password === password);
    if (!user) { message.textContent = 'Invalid email or password.'; return; }
    localStorage.setItem('ticketsafe_current_user', JSON.stringify({name:user.name,email:user.email}));
    message.textContent = 'Login successful!';
    setTimeout(() => { closeAuthModal(); updateAuthButton(); }, 650);
  }
}
function updateAuthButton() {
  const btn = document.querySelector('.login-btn');
  if (!btn) return;
  try {
    const user = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('ticketsafe_current_user') || 'null');
    if (user && user.name) {
      btn.innerHTML = '👤&nbsp; ' + escapeBookingText(user.name.split(' ')[0]) + ' / Logout';
      btn.onclick = function(){ localStorage.removeItem('ticketsafe_current_user'); updateAuthButton(); };
      return;
    }
  } catch(e) {}
  btn.innerHTML = '♙&nbsp; Login / Signup';
  btn.onclick = function(){ openAuthModal('login'); };
}
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', updateAuthButton);
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){ if(e.key === 'Escape') closeAuthModal(); });
</script>

<script>
/* =========================================================
   TICKETSAFE PRO MAX — FRONTEND DEMO ENHANCEMENTS
   Booking flow is intentionally kept simple.
========================================================= */
(function(){
  const originalChangeCategory = window.changeCategory;
  const originalDisplayResults = window.displayResults;
  const originalStartBooking = window.startBooking;
  const originalCreateSeats = window.createSeats;
  const originalConfirmBooking = window.confirmBooking;
  const originalRenderMyBookings = window.renderMyBookings;

  function allCategoryData(cat){
    return cat==='bus'?buses:cat==='train'?trains:cat==='flight'?flights:cat==='movie'?movies:cat==='event'?events:cat==='podcast'?podcasts:cat==='cricket'?cricket:cat==='kabaddi'?kabaddi:[];
  }
  function fmt(n){return Number(n||0).toLocaleString('en-IN')}
  function todayLabel(){return new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-IN',{day:'2-digit',month:'short',year:'numeric'})}
  function favKey(cat,index){return cat+'_'+index}
  function favorites(){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('ticketsafe_favorites')||'[]')}catch(e){return[]}}
  function setFavorites(a){localStorage.setItem('ticketsafe_favorites',JSON.stringify(a))}
  window.toggleFavorite=function(cat,index){
    const a=favorites(),k=favKey(cat,index),i=a.indexOf(k);
    if(i>=0)a.splice(i,1);else a.push(k);
    setFavorites(a); displayResults(currentResults||allCategoryData(cat));
    toast(i>=0?'Removed from Favorites':'❤️ Added to Favorites');
  };

  window.toast=function(msg){
    let t=document.getElementById('tsToast');
    if(!t){t=document.createElement('div');t.id='tsToast';t.style.cssText='position:fixed;right:22px;bottom:22px;z-index:2000;background:#101828;color:#fff;padding:13px 17px;border-radius:12px;font:700 13px Inter;box-shadow:0 15px 35px rgba(0,0,0,.2);opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px);transition:.25s';document.body.appendChild(t)}
    t.textContent=msg;t.style.opacity='1';t.style.transform='translateY(0)';clearTimeout(t._x);t._x=setTimeout(()=>{t.style.opacity='0';t.style.transform='translateY(10px)'},1800)
  };

  /* Enhanced category/search bar */
  function injectSearch(){
    const box=document.getElementById('travelSearch'); if(!box)return;
    box.className='search-area search-enhanced';
    box.innerHTML='<input id="tsSearch" type="search" placeholder="🔎 Search service, route or location..." oninput="applyServiceFilters()"><select id="tsSort" onchange="applyServiceFilters()"><option value="default">Sort: Recommended</option><option value="priceAsc">Price: Low → High</option><option value="priceDesc">Price: High → Low</option><option value="name">Name A → Z</option></select><select id="tsAvailability" onchange="applyServiceFilters()"><option value="all">All Services</option><option value="available">Available Seats</option><option value="favorites">❤️ Favorites</option></select><button class="ts-btn purple" onclick="applyServiceFilters()">Search</button><div id="tsSearchCount" class="search-count" style="grid-column:1/-1"></div>';
  }
  window.applyServiceFilters=function(){
    const q=(document.getElementById('tsSearch')?.value||'').toLowerCase().trim();
    const sort=document.getElementById('tsSort')?.value||'default';
    const mode=document.getElementById('tsAvailability')?.value||'all';
    let data=[...(currentResults||allCategoryData(currentCategory))];
    data=data.filter((x,i)=>{
      const hay=[x.name,x.from,x.to,x.location,x.screen,x.time].filter(Boolean).join(' ').toLowerCase();
      const fav=favorites().includes(favKey(currentCategory,i));
      return (!q||hay.includes(q))&&(mode!=='favorites'||fav);
    });
    if(sort==='priceAsc')data.sort((a,b)=>Number(a.price||0)-Number(b.price||0));
    if(sort==='priceDesc')data.sort((a,b)=>Number(b.price||0)-Number(a.price||0));
    if(sort==='name')data.sort((a,b)=>String(a.name).localeCompare(String(b.name)));
    window.__filteredResults=data;
    displayResults(data);
    const c=document.getElementById('tsSearchCount');if(c)c.textContent=`Showing ${data.length} service${data.length===1?'':'s'} in ${String(currentCategory).toUpperCase()}`;
  };

  window.displayResults=function(data){
    const results=document.getElementById('results');if(!results)return;
    currentResults=data;
    results.innerHTML='';
    if(!data.length){results.innerHTML='<div style="grid-column:1/-1;background:#fff;padding:45px;border-radius:18px;text-align:center;border:1px solid #eaecf0"><div style="font-size:35px">🔎</div><h2 style="margin-top:8px">No services found</h2><p style="color:#667085;margin-top:5px">Try another search or category.</p></div>';return;}
    const cat=currentCategory;
    data.forEach((item,index)=>{
      const card=document.createElement('div');card.className='card';
      const originalIndex=allCategoryData(cat).indexOf(item);
      const isFav=favorites().includes(favKey(cat,originalIndex));
      let location=item.from?`📍 ${escapeBookingText(item.from)} → ${escapeBookingText(item.to)}`:`📍 ${escapeBookingText(item.location||'TicketSafe Venue')}`;
      let extra='';
      if(cat==='event'&&item.dates)extra=`<div class="info showtime-box">📅 <strong>Event Date</strong><select class="showtime-select" id="eventdate-${index}" onchange="updateEventDate(${index},this.value)">${item.dates.map(d=>`<option value="${d.value}" ${d.value===item.date?'selected':''}>${d.label}</option>`).join('')}</select></div>`;
      if(cat==='movie'||cat==='podcast')extra+=item.screen?`<div class="info">🎬 <strong>${escapeBookingText(item.screen)}</strong></div>`:'';
      const timeIcon=(cat==='event'?'🕒':'⏰');
      extra+=`<div class="info">${timeIcon} <strong>${cat==='cricket'||cat==='kabaddi'?'Entry Time:':'Time:'}</strong> ${escapeBookingText(item.time||'—')}</div>`;
      const price=Number(item.price||0);
      const hideScreenPrice=['movie','event','podcast'].includes(cat);
      const servicePriceTag=hideScreenPrice?'':`<span class="service-tag">${price?'₹'+fmt(price):'Seat Booking'}</span>`;
      const priceRow=hideScreenPrice?'':`<div class="price-row"><div class="price movie-card-price">₹${fmt(price)} <small>/ seat</small></div><button class="book-btn" onclick="bookResult(${originalIndex},'${cat}')">Book Now →</button></div>`;
      const bookRow=hideScreenPrice?`<div style="display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin-top:13px"><button class="book-btn" onclick="bookResult(${originalIndex},'${cat}')">Book Now →</button></div>`:'';
      card.innerHTML=`<button class="card-fav ${isFav?'active':''}" title="Favorite" onclick="toggleFavorite('${cat}',${originalIndex})">${isFav?'♥':'♡'}</button>
        <div class="card-top"><img src="${photoFor(cat)}" alt="${escapeBookingText(cat)}"></div>
        <div class="card-content"><h3>${escapeBookingText(item.name)}</h3><div class="info">${location}</div>${extra}
        <div class="service-extra"><span class="service-tag">${String(cat).toUpperCase()}</span>${servicePriceTag}</div>
        ${priceRow}${bookRow}</div>`;
      results.appendChild(card);
    });
    const c=document.getElementById('tsSearchCount');if(c)c.textContent=`Showing ${data.length} service${data.length===1?'':'s'} in ${String(cat).toUpperCase()}`;
  };

  window.changeCategory=function(category,button){
    currentCategory=category;
    document.querySelectorAll('.category').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('active'));if(button)button.classList.add('active');
    const data=allCategoryData(category);currentResults=data;
    document.getElementById('resultTitle').textContent=(category==='bus'?'🚌 Available Bus':category==='train'?'🚆 Available Train':category==='flight'?'✈️ Available Flight':category==='movie'?'🎬 Available Movies':category==='event'?'🎉 Available Events':category==='podcast'?'🎙️ Available Podcasts':category==='cricket'?'🏏 Available Cricket': '🤼 Available Kabaddi');
    document.getElementById('travelSearch').style.display='grid';
    injectSearch();
    document.getElementById('activeBlock').style.display='block';document.getElementById('popularBlock').style.display='none';
    displayResults(data);
    window.scrollTo({top:document.getElementById('explore').offsetTop-80,behavior:'smooth'});
  };

  /* Start booking: add local seat availability and progress */
  window.startBooking=function(service,categoryOverride){
    originalStartBooking(service,categoryOverride);
    const cat=currentCategory;
    const old=currentResults;
    setTimeout(()=>{
      syncLocalBookedSeats();
      const sec=document.getElementById('bookingSection');
      let prog=document.getElementById('bookingProgress');
      if(!prog){
        prog=document.createElement('div');prog.id='bookingProgress';prog.className='booking-progress';
        sec.querySelector('.booking-header').after(prog);
      }
      prog.innerHTML='<span class="progress-step active">① Select Seats</span><span class="progress-step active">② Passenger Details</span><span class="progress-step">③ Confirm Ticket</span>';
      updateBookingSummary();
    },30);
  };

  window.updateBookingSummary=function(){
    let el=document.getElementById('tsBookingSummary');
    const header=document.querySelector('#bookingSection .booking-header');if(!header)return;
    if(!el){el=document.createElement('div');el.id='tsBookingSummary';el.style.cssText='margin:0 0 16px;padding:15px 17px;border:1px solid #e4e7ec;border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff,#faf8ff);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:15px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap';header.after(el)}
    const price=Number(selectedService?.price||0),count=(selectedSeats||[]).length;
    el.innerHTML=`<div><div style="font-size:10px;color:#667085;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase">Booking Summary</div><strong>${escapeBookingText(selectedService?.name||'Service')}</strong><div style="font-size:12px;color:#667085">${escapeBookingText(selectedService?.from?selectedService.from+' → '+selectedService.to:(selectedService?.location||''))}</div></div><div style="text-align:right"><div style="font-size:12px;color:#667085">${count} seat${count===1?'':'s'} selected</div><strong style="font:800 22px Manrope;color:#6d35df">₹${fmt(price*count)}</strong></div>`;
  };

  const oldToggle=window.toggleSeat;
  window.toggleSeat=function(number){oldToggle(number);updateBookingSummary()};

  window.createSeats=function(){
    originalCreateSeats();
    setTimeout(syncLocalBookedSeats,10);
  };
  function syncLocalBookedSeats(){
    const cat=currentCategory, service=selectedService;if(!service)return;
    const booked=getSavedBookings().filter(b=>b.category===cat && b.service===service.name && b.bookingStatus!=='CANCELLED').flatMap(b=>Array.isArray(b.seats)?b.seats:[]);
    document.querySelectorAll('#seatContainer .seat').forEach(el=>{
      const label=el.getAttribute('aria-label')?.replace(/^Seat\s+/,'')||el.title;
      if(booked.includes(label)){el.classList.remove('available','selected');el.classList.add('booked');el.disabled=true;el.onclick=null}
    });
  }

  /* Booking wrapper: preserve original validation/lock, then add rich ticket data */
  window.confirmBooking=function(){
    const before=getSavedBookings().length;
    originalConfirmBooking();
    const after=getSavedBookings();
    if(after.length<=before)return;
    const b=after[after.length-1];
    b.total=(selectedSeats||[]).length*Number(selectedService?.price||0);
    b.date=b.date||new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
    b.bookingStatus='CONFIRMED';
    b.verificationCode='TS-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,8).toUpperCase();
    localStorage.setItem('ticketsafe_bookings',JSON.stringify(after));
    incrementNotification('booking',b);
    const s=document.getElementById('successText');
    if(s)s.innerHTML=`<div style="font-size:15px;line-height:1.7"><strong>Booking Status:</strong> <span style="color:#027a48">CONFIRMED</span><br><strong>Booking ID:</strong> ${escapeBookingText(b.bookingId)}<br><strong>Seats:</strong> ${escapeBookingText(b.seats.join(', '))}<br><strong>Total:</strong> ₹${fmt(b.total)}</div><div class="pro-actions" style="margin-top:18px"><button class="ts-btn purple" onclick="openTicketById('${escapeBookingText(b.bookingId)}')">🎫 View Digital Ticket</button><button class="ts-btn secondary" onclick="showMyBookings()">My Bookings</button></div>`;
    const prog=document.getElementById('bookingProgress');if(prog)prog.innerHTML='<span class="progress-step active">✓ Seats Selected</span><span class="progress-step active">✓ Details Verified</span><span class="progress-step active">✓ Ticket Confirmed</span>';
    updateBookingSummary();
    renderProDashboard();
  };

  /* Rich bookings list */
  window.renderMyBookings=function(){
    const list=document.getElementById('myBookingsList');if(!list)return;
    const bookings=getSavedBookings().slice().reverse();
    if(!bookings.length){list.innerHTML='<div class="empty-bookings"><h3>No bookings yet</h3><p>After you complete a ticket booking, it will appear here.</p></div>';return}
    list.innerHTML=bookings.map(b=>{
      const cancelled=b.bookingStatus==='CANCELLED',passengers=Array.isArray(b.passengers)?b.passengers:[],seats=Array.isArray(b.seats)?b.seats.join(', '):'—';
      return `<article class="booking-card" style="position:relative"><span class="booking-status">${cancelled?'CANCELLED':'CONFIRMED'} • ${escapeBookingText(String(b.category||'ticket').toUpperCase())}</span><h3>${escapeBookingText(b.service||'Ticket')}</h3><div class="booking-meta"><strong>Booking ID:</strong> ${escapeBookingText(b.bookingId||'—')}<br><strong>Route:</strong> ${escapeBookingText(b.route||'—')}<br><strong>Date:</strong> ${escapeBookingText(b.date||'—')}<br><strong>Time:</strong> ${escapeBookingText(b.time||'—')}<br><strong>Seats:</strong> ${escapeBookingText(seats)}<br><strong>Persons:</strong> ${passengers.length}</div><div class="booking-total">₹${fmt(b.total)}</div><div class="pro-actions" style="margin-top:12px"><button class="ts-btn secondary" onclick="openTicketById('${escapeBookingText(b.bookingId)}')">🎫 Ticket</button>${!cancelled?`<button class="ts-btn danger" onclick="cancelTicket('${escapeBookingText(b.bookingId)}')">Cancel</button>`:''}</div></article>`;
    }).join('');
  };

  window.cancelTicket=function(id){
    const a=getSavedBookings(),i=a.findIndex(b=>b.bookingId===id);if(i<0)return;
    if(a[i].bookingStatus==='CANCELLED')return;
    if(!confirm('Cancel this TicketSafe booking?'))return;
    a[i].bookingStatus='CANCELLED';a[i].cancelledAt=new Date().toISOString();localStorage.setItem('ticketsafe_bookings',JSON.stringify(a));
    incrementNotification('cancel',a[i]);renderMyBookings();renderProDashboard();toast('Ticket cancelled successfully');
  };

  window.openTicketById=function(id){
    const b=getSavedBookings().find(x=>x.bookingId===id);if(!b)return;
    window.__activeTicket=b;
    document.getElementById('ticketService').textContent=b.service||'Confirmed Ticket';
    document.getElementById('ticketBookingId').textContent=b.bookingId||'—';
    document.getElementById('ticketRoute').textContent=b.route||b.service||'—';
    document.getElementById('ticketCategory').textContent=String(b.category||'ticket').toUpperCase();
    document.getElementById('ticketStatus').textContent=b.bookingStatus||'CONFIRMED';
    document.getElementById('ticketDate').textContent=b.date||'—';
    document.getElementById('ticketTime').textContent=b.time||'—';
    document.getElementById('ticketSeats').textContent=Array.isArray(b.seats)?b.seats.join(', '):'—';
    document.getElementById('ticketPersons').textContent=Array.isArray(b.passengers)?b.passengers.length:'—';
    document.getElementById('ticketTotal').textContent='₹'+fmt(b.total);
    const qr=document.getElementById('ticketQr');qr.innerHTML='';
    const seed=String(b.bookingId||'TICKET');for(let i=0;i<169;i++){const n=seed.charCodeAt(i%seed.length)+i*17;const d=document.createElement('i');if(((n%5===0)||(n%7===0)||(n%11===0))&&!(i%13===0))d.style.background='#101828';else d.style.background='#fff';qr.appendChild(d)}
    document.getElementById('ticketOverlay').style.display='flex';
  };
  window.closeTicketModal=function(){document.getElementById('ticketOverlay').style.display='none'};
  window.closeTicketOnBackdrop=function(e){if(e.target.id==='ticketOverlay')closeTicketModal()};
  window.printTicket=function(){const b=window.__activeTicket;if(!b)return;const w=window.open('','_blank','width=800,height=700');w.document.write(`<html><head><title>${b.bookingId}</title><style>body{font-family:Arial;padding:30px}h1{color:#6d35df}.box{border:1px solid #ddd;padding:18px;border-radius:12px;margin-top:15px}</style></head><body><h1>TicketSafe</h1><h2>Digital Ticket</h2><div class="box"><b>Booking ID:</b> ${escapeBookingText(b.bookingId)}<br><b>Service:</b> ${escapeBookingText(b.service)}<br><b>Route:</b> ${escapeBookingText(b.route||'—')}<br><b>Date:</b> ${escapeBookingText(b.date||'—')}<br><b>Time:</b> ${escapeBookingText(b.time||'—')}<br><b>Seats:</b> ${escapeBookingText((b.seats||[]).join(', '))}<br><b>Status:</b> ${escapeBookingText(b.bookingStatus||'CONFIRMED')}<br><b>Total:</b> ₹${fmt(b.total)}</div><script>window.print();<\/script>
</body></html>`);w.document.close()};
  window.downloadTicketHtml=function(){const b=window.__activeTicket;if(!b)return;const body=`<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><title>${b.bookingId}</title><style>body{font-family:Arial;background:#f7f9fc;padding:30px}.ticket{max-width:700px;margin:auto;background:#fff;padding:28px;border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px #ddd}.brand{font-size:28px;font-weight:900;color:#6d35df}.row{padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #eee}</style></head><body><div class="ticket"><div class="brand">TicketSafe</div><h2>Digital Ticket</h2>${[['Booking ID',b.bookingId],['Service',b.service],['Route',b.route||'—'],['Date',b.date||'—'],['Time',b.time||'—'],['Seats',(b.seats||[]).join(', ')],['Status',b.bookingStatus||'CONFIRMED'],['Total','₹'+fmt(b.total)]].map(x=>`<div class="row"><b>${escapeBookingText(x[0])}:</b> ${escapeBookingText(x[1])}</div>`).join('')}</div></body></html>`;const blob=new Blob([body],{type:'text/html'}),url=URL.createObjectURL(blob),a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download=`TicketSafe_${b.bookingId}.html`;a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),1000)};

  /* Pro dashboard */
  window.openProDashboard=function(){
    hideInfoPages();document.querySelector('.hero').style.display='none';document.querySelector('.booking-box').style.display='none';document.getElementById('explore').style.display='none';document.getElementById('myBookings').style.display='none';document.getElementById('bookingSection').style.display='none';document.getElementById('profilePage').style.display='none';document.getElementById('proCenter').style.display='block';resetNavActive();document.getElementById('proNav').classList.add('nav-active');renderProDashboard();document.getElementById('proCenter').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'});
  };
  window.renderProDashboard=function(){
    const b=getSavedBookings(),confirmed=b.filter(x=>x.bookingStatus!=='CANCELLED'),cancelled=b.filter(x=>x.bookingStatus==='CANCELLED');
    const seats=confirmed.reduce((s,x)=>s+(Array.isArray(x.seats)?x.seats.length:0),0),value=confirmed.reduce((s,x)=>s+Number(x.total||0),0);
    document.getElementById('statBookings').textContent=b.length;document.getElementById('statSeats').textContent=seats;document.getElementById('statLocks').textContent=localStorage.getItem('ticketsafe_booking_lock')?'1':'0';document.getElementById('statConflicts').textContent=localStorage.getItem('ticketsafe_conflicts')||'0';document.getElementById('statValue').textContent='₹'+fmt(value);document.getElementById('statCancelled').textContent=cancelled.length;
    const counts={};confirmed.forEach(x=>counts[x.category]=(counts[x.category]||0)+(Array.isArray(x.seats)?x.seats.length:1));const max=Math.max(1,...Object.values(counts));
    document.getElementById('categoryAnalytics').innerHTML=Object.keys(counts).length?Object.entries(counts).map(([k,v])=>`<div class="chart-row"><b>${escapeBookingText(k.toUpperCase())}</b><div class="bar-track"><div class="bar-fill" style="width:${Math.round(v/max*100)}%"></div></div><strong>${v}</strong></div>`).join(''):'<div class="empty-pro">No booking data yet.</div>';
    document.getElementById('systemHealth').innerHTML='<div class="service-extra"><span class="service-tag">🟢 Booking Engine Ready</span><span class="service-tag">🟢 Local Lock Active</span><span class="service-tag">🟢 Ticket Generator Ready</span><span class="service-tag">🟡 Backend: Demo Mode</span></div><p style="color:#667085;margin-top:12px;font-size:13px">The current standalone website stores demo records in browser localStorage. MySQL/API integration can replace this layer for multi-user deployment.</p>';
    document.getElementById('recentActivity').innerHTML=renderRecentRows(b.slice().reverse().slice(0,8));
    renderAdminBookings();
  };
  function renderRecentRows(arr){if(!arr.length)return'<div class="empty-pro">No bookings yet.</div>';return`<table class="recent-table"><thead><tr><th>ID</th><th>Service</th><th>Category</th><th>Seats</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead><tbody>${arr.map(b=>`<tr><td>${escapeBookingText(b.bookingId)}</td><td>${escapeBookingText(b.service)}</td><td>${escapeBookingText(String(b.category||'').toUpperCase())}</td><td>${escapeBookingText((b.seats||[]).join(', '))}</td><td><span class="status-pill ${b.bookingStatus==='CANCELLED'?'cancelled':''}">${escapeBookingText(b.bookingStatus||'CONFIRMED')}</span></td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table>`}
  window.renderAdminBookings=function(){
    const el=document.getElementById('adminBookingsList');if(!el)return;
    const q=(document.getElementById('adminBookingSearch')?.value||'').toLowerCase();
    let b=getSavedBookings().slice().reverse().filter(x=>[x.bookingId,x.service,x.category,x.route].join(' ').toLowerCase().includes(q));
    if(!b.length){el.innerHTML='<div class="empty-pro">No matching bookings.</div>';return}
    el.innerHTML=`<table class="recent-table"><thead><tr><th>ID</th><th>Service</th><th>Category</th><th>Seats</th><th>Status</th><th>Actions</th></tr></thead><tbody>${b.map(x=>`<tr>
      <td>${escapeBookingText(x.bookingId)}</td><td>${escapeBookingText(x.service)}</td><td>${escapeBookingText(String(x.category||'').toUpperCase())}</td>
      <td>${escapeBookingText((x.seats||[]).join(', '))}</td><td><span class="status-pill ${x.bookingStatus==='CANCELLED'?'cancelled':''}">${escapeBookingText(x.bookingStatus||'CONFIRMED')}</span></td>
      <td><div class="pro-actions"><button class="ts-btn secondary" onclick="openTicketById('${escapeBookingText(x.bookingId)}')">View</button><button class="ts-btn secondary" onclick="printAdminTicket('${escapeBookingText(x.bookingId)}')">Print</button>${x.bookingStatus!=='CANCELLED'?`<button class="ts-btn danger" onclick="cancelTicket('${escapeBookingText(x.bookingId)}')">Cancel</button>`:''}</div></td>
    </tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table>`;
  };
  window.printAdminTicket=function(id){openTicketById(id);setTimeout(()=>printTicket(),120)};
  window.switchProTab=function(tab,btn){
    document.querySelectorAll('.pro-tab').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('active'));if(btn)btn.classList.add('active');
    document.querySelectorAll('.pro-panel').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('active'));document.getElementById('pro-'+tab).classList.add('active');
    if(tab==='bookings')renderAdminBookings();if(tab==='profile')renderProfilePanel();
  };

  /* Profile */
  function currentUser(){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('ticketsafe_current_user')||'null')}catch(e){return null}}
  function profileHTML(){
    const u=currentUser()||{name:'Guest User',email:'Not logged in'}, b=getSavedBookings(),initial=(u.name||'G').split(' ').map(x=>x[0]).join('').slice(0,2).toUpperCase();
    return `<div class="profile-card"><div class="avatar">${escapeBookingText(initial)}</div><div><h2 style="font:800 24px Manrope">${escapeBookingText(u.name)}</h2><p style="color:#667085;margin-top:4px">${escapeBookingText(u.email)}</p><div class="profile-fields" style="margin-top:15px"><div class="profile-field"><small>Total Bookings</small><strong>${b.length}</strong></div><div class="profile-field"><small>Confirmed</small><strong>${b.filter(x=>x.bookingStatus!=='CANCELLED').length}</strong></div><div class="profile-field"><small>Seats Booked</small><strong>${b.filter(x=>x.bookingStatus!=='CANCELLED').reduce((s,x)=>s+(x.seats||[]).length,0)}</strong></div><div class="profile-field"><small>Favorites</small><strong>${favorites().length}</strong></div></div></div></div>`;
  }
  function renderProfilePanel(){const e=document.getElementById('profilePanel');if(e)e.innerHTML=profileHTML()}
  window.openProfile=function(){document.getElementById('profilePage').style.display='block';document.getElementById('proCenter').style.display='none';document.querySelector('.hero').style.display='none';document.querySelector('.booking-box').style.display='none';document.getElementById('explore').style.display='none';document.getElementById('myBookings').style.display='none';document.getElementById('bookingSection').style.display='none';hideInfoPages();renderProfilePage();window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'})};
  function renderProfilePage(){const e=document.getElementById('profilePageContent');if(e)e.innerHTML=profileHTML()+`<div style="margin-top:20px"><button class="ts-btn secondary" onclick="openAuthModal('signup')">✏️ Edit / Login Account</button></div>`}
  window.renderProfilePage=renderProfilePage;

  /* Notifications */
  function notifications(){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('ticketsafe_notifications')||'[]')}catch(e){return[]}}
  function setNotifications(a){localStorage.setItem('ticketsafe_notifications',JSON.stringify(a.slice(-30)))}
  function incrementNotification(type,b){const a=notifications();a.push({type,time:new Date().toISOString(),message:type==='booking'?`Booking ${b.bookingId} confirmed for ${b.service}.`:`Booking ${b.bookingId} was cancelled.`});setNotifications(a)}
  function seedNotifications(){if(notifications().length)return;setNotifications([{type:'system',time:new Date().toISOString(),message:'TicketSafe Pro Center is ready. Run the Concurrency Lab to demonstrate safe seat locking.'}])}
  window.openNotifications=function(){seedNotifications();document.getElementById('notifyOverlay').style.display='flex';renderNotifications()};
  window.closeNotifications=function(){document.getElementById('notifyOverlay').style.display='none'};
  window.closeNotificationsOnBackdrop=function(e){if(e.target.id==='notifyOverlay')closeNotifications()};
  function renderNotifications(){const e=document.getElementById('notificationList');if(!e)return;const a=notifications().slice().reverse();e.innerHTML=a.length?a.map(n=>`<div class="notify-item"><div class="notify-dot"></div><div><strong>${escapeBookingText(n.message)}</strong><div style="font-size:11px;color:#667085;margin-top:4px">${new Date(n.time).toLocaleString()}</div></div></div>`).join(''):'<div class="empty-pro">No notifications.</div>'}

  /* Concurrency simulator */
  window.runRaceSimulation=function(){
    const seat=['A15','B12','C07','A21'][Math.floor(Math.random()*4)];document.getElementById('raceSeat').textContent=seat;
    const log=document.getElementById('raceLog');const a=document.getElementById('raceA'),b=document.getElementById('raceB');
    a.textContent='Requesting lock...';b.textContent='Requesting lock...';log.textContent='[0ms] User A → lock request for '+seat+'\\n[5ms] User B → lock request for '+seat+'\\n';
    setTimeout(()=>{a.textContent='✅ LOCK ACQUIRED';log.textContent+='[18ms] User A → LOCK ACQUIRED\\n';},220);
    setTimeout(()=>{b.textContent='🛑 BLOCKED — seat already locked';log.textContent+='[21ms] User B → BLOCKED\\n';localStorage.setItem('ticketsafe_conflicts',String(Number(localStorage.getItem('ticketsafe_conflicts')||0)+1));renderProDashboard()},430);
  };
window.exportTicketSafeData=function(){
    const data={generatedAt:new Date().toISOString(),bookings:getSavedBookings(),favorites:favorites(),notifications:notifications(),concurrencyConflicts:Number(localStorage.getItem('ticketsafe_conflicts')||0)};
    const blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify(data,null,2)],{type:'application/json'}),url=URL.createObjectURL(blob),a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download='TicketSafe_Export.json';a.click();URL.revokeObjectURL(url);toast('Booking data exported');
  };

  /* Patch home/bookings navigation to include new screens */
  const oldShowHome=window.showHome;
  window.showHome=function(){document.getElementById('proCenter').style.display='none';document.getElementById('profilePage').style.display='none';oldShowHome();injectSearch();seedNotifications()};
  const oldShowMy=window.showMyBookings;
  window.showMyBookings=function(){document.getElementById('proCenter').style.display='none';document.getElementById('profilePage').style.display='none';oldShowMy();};
  const oldShowInfo=window.showInfoPage;
  window.showInfoPage=function(page){document.getElementById('proCenter').style.display='none';document.getElementById('profilePage').style.display='none';oldShowInfo(page)};

  window.addEventListener('storage',()=>{try{if(document.getElementById('seatContainer')&&selectedService)syncLocalBookedSeats();renderProDashboard()}catch(e){}});

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',()=>{
    injectSearch();seedNotifications();updateAuthButton();
    const first=document.querySelector('.category.active');if(first)changeCategory(currentCategory||'bus',first);
  });
})();
</script>

<script id="ticketsafe-v2-js">
(function(){
  window.__tsBookingStatus='all';
  window.toggleTSMobileMenu=function(){const m=document.getElementById('tsMobileMenu');if(m)m.classList.toggle('open')};
  window.closeTSMobileMenu=function(){const m=document.getElementById('tsMobileMenu');if(m)m.classList.remove('open')};
  document.addEventListener('click',function(e){const m=document.getElementById('tsMobileMenu'),t=document.getElementById('tsMobileToggle');if(m&&m.classList.contains('open')&&!m.contains(e.target)&&e.target!==t)closeTSMobileMenu()});
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',function(){
    const nav=document.querySelector('header nav');
    if(nav&&!document.getElementById('profileNav')){const a=document.createElement('a');a.id='profileNav';a.href='#profilePage';a.textContent='Profile';a.onclick=function(e){e.preventDefault();openProfile()};const login=nav.querySelector('.login-btn');if(login)nav.insertBefore(a,login);}
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
